	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	k.Selection.Value = FORMTARIHI

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = Trim(TERMINSIPARISNO)
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Value = "00"
	
	For j = 2 To 2 
		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-4).Select
		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 7 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(5, i),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i)).Select
		k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BÝRÝNCÝ KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRESLERÝNÝ MERGE ve ORTALA
	For m = 1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 2
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SAYFA ADINI DEÐÝÞTÝRÝR
'------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = ""
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = ""
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.196850393700787)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 63
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$3"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu

Kod : 
Public k,Sheet,SAYAC,j,Wb,ddd,KAYITSAYISI,GRID,SATIR_BASLANGIC,KOLON_BASLANGIC,SUTUN_BASLANGIC,SATIRNO, SUTUNNO,BASLIKALTISATIRNO
Public 	TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI, TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, DEGERLERSONSATIR , 	ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintForm()

	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	Set ddd = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	
	k.Visible = True

	SUTUN_BASLANGIC = 1
	SATIR_BASLANGIC  = 4
	
	Set TABLO = Doc.Select1("ABC","BOMU01T","BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE ='FASON-001 '","BOMREC_OPERASYON",-1)
	TABLO.Sort("BOMREC_OPERASYON")
	TABLO.GroupBy("BOMREC_OPERASYON")
	
	'FASON LÝSTESÝ
	Sheet.Cells(SATIR_BASLANGIC, SUTUN_BASLANGIC).Value = "FASON LÝSTESÝ"
	SATIRNO = SATIR_BASLANGIC + 1
	SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC

 	Call DEGERLER (TABLO)
	
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub BASLIKLAR ()

	'ARABASLIK KONUMU
	SATIR_ARA_BASLIK = SATIRNO
	SUTUN_ARA_BASLIK = SUTUNNO

	'SIRA NO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "S.NO"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC + 1

	'YARI MAMÜL RESMÝ
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Y.MAMUL RESMÝ"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'MAMÜL RESMÝ
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "MAMUL RESMÝ"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'GÝDÝÞ DÖNÜÞ ÖPS PARÇA KODU ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "GÝDÝÞ/DÖNÜÞ ÖPS PARÇA KODU/ADI"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 3

	'FASON KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "FASON KODU"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'ÖPS MAMUL KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "ÖPS MAMUL KODU"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'MÜÞTERÝ PARÇA KODU / ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "MÜÞTERÝ PARÇA KODU / ADI"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'FASONCU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "FASONCU"

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI = SUTUNNO	

		'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = SUTUN_ARA_BASLIK to 	TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI 
		Sheet.Cells(SATIR_ARA_BASLIK, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next

	ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM = SATIRNO
	
End Sub

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DEGERLER(TABLO)
	
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	For t = 1 to 2' TABLO.GETROWCOUNT
		'FASON ADINA GÖRE FÝLTRELEME
		QQQ = "BOMREC_OPERASYON='"+Doc.LeftJustify(TABLO.BOMREC_OPERASYON(t), 3)+"'"
		Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "BOMU01T", QQQ, "", -1)
		KayitSayisi = FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR.GetRowCount()
		FASONADI_X	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("IMLT01","AD",Trim(TABLO.BOMREC_OPERASYON(t)),"")
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FASON ADI BAÞLIK	
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASONADI_X
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SAYAC = 0
		Call BASLIKLAR
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		For i=1 To KayitSayisi
			QQQ = "BOMREC_OPERASYON='"+Doc.LeftJustify(TABLO.BOMREC_OPERASYON(t), 3)+"'"
			Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "BOMU01T", QQQ, "", -1)
			FASONDAN_GELEN = FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR.BOMREC_YMAMULCODE(i)
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'SIRANO
			SAYAC = SAYAC + 1
			ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM  = ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM + 1
			Sheet.Cells(ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM, SUTUN_BASLANGIC).Value = SAYAC
			SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC + 1
			SATIRNO = ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
			'FASONA GÝDENÝN KODU
			QQQ = "EVRAKNO='"+Doc.LeftJustify(FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR.EVRAKNO(i), 10)+"'"
			Set FASONA_GIDEN_ICIN_TABLO = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "BOMU01T", QQQ, "", -1)
			FASONA_GIDEN = Trim(FASONA_GIDEN_ICIN_TABLO.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(1))
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'RESÝM EKLE
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
			STOKKODU_GIDEN = 	FASONA_GIDEN
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU_GIDEN & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				RESIM1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Top+1.5
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Left+1.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
    			k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 20
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 30
			End if
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASONA GÝDENÝN KODU
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			FASONA_GIDEN_AD = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "( " & FASONA_GIDEN & " )" & CHR(10) & FASONA_GIDEN_AD
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASON KODU
			FASON_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_7",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASON_KODU
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASONDAN GELENÝN KODU
			FASONDAN_GELEN_AD = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",Trim(FASONDAN_GIDEN),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "( " & FASONDAN_GELEN & " )" & CHR(10) & FASONA_GIDEN_AD
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO +1
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU_GIDEN & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				If Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,1)="M" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="YM" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,3)="FYM" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HR" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HS" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HB" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HP" Then 
					RESIM1 	= Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", FASONDAN_GELEN +"000001", "EVRAKNO+SUBSRNUM"))
				Else
					RESIM1 	= Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", FASONDAN_GELEN +"000002", "EVRAKNO+SUBSRNUM"))
				End If
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Top+1.5	
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Left+1.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
	    		k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 20
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 30
			End if
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'OPS_PARCA_MAMUL_KODU
			If Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,1)	= "M" Then
				OPS_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","KOD",Trim(FASONDAN_GELEN),-1))
			Else
				OPS_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","TSENO",Trim(FASONDAN_GELEN),-1))
			End If
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "'" & OPS_PARCA_KODU 
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU
			MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",Trim(OPS_PARCA_KODU),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "'" & MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'MUSTERI_PARCA_ADI
			MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","NAME2",Trim(OPS_PARCA_KODU),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "'" & MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASONCU
			If Left(Trim(FASON_KODU),2) = "K-" Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "KARAKAYA"
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_5",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			End If
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Nothing
		Next
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Nothing
	Next
	Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Nothing
	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO

	Call MAKYAJ

End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MAKYAJ()

	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'LOGO MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(3, 2)).Merge
		'LOGO RESMÝ
	LOGO=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\opsLOGO.jpg"
	RTOPLOGO = Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Top+1.5
	RLEFTLOGO= Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Left+1.5
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set LOGORES = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(LOGO)) 
	RESIMLOGOADI=LOGORES.Name
	Sheet.Shapes(RESIMLOGOADI).Select
	LOGORES.Left = RLEFTLOGO 
	LOGORES.Top  = RTOPLOGO
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 40
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 90
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FORM BAÞLIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 3), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-7)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Value = "FORD OTOSAN SAN. AÞ. - SÝPARÝÞ FORMU"
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 24
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO BAÞIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-6).Value = "TARÝH"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-6).Value = "SÝP.NO"

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-6), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-5)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-6).Value = "REV.NO"

	'TARÝH - SÝPNO - REV HÜCRELERÝNÝ BOYA 
	For i = 1 To 3
		Sheet.Cells(i, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-6).Select
		'k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 1 
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'TARÝH-SÝP.NO-REV.NO DEÐER MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	k.Selection.Value = FORMTARIHI

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4).Value = Trim(TERMINSIPARISNO)
	Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4).Select

	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4), Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4).Select
	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
	k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
	Sheet.Cells(3, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4).Value = "00"
	
	For j = 2 To 2 
		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4).Select
		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 7 to TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(5, i),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i)).Select
		k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BÝRÝNCÝ KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 6
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRESLERÝNÝ MERGE ve ORTALA
	For m = 1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Merge
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKSATIR_ARR(m), 1).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 2
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SAYFA ADINI DEÐÝÞTÝRÝR
'------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = ""
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = ""
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.196850393700787)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 63
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$3"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : FASON_LST5
Hangi Tablo için : BOMU01
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : STOK00
Açýklama : FASON GÝDEN GELEN YARIMAMUL-MAMÜL VE FASON KOD RESÝMLÝ LÝSTE (EXCELE) (mozan)
Kod : 
Public k,Sheet,SAYAC,j,Wb,ddd,KAYITSAYISI,GRID,SATIR_BASLANGIC,KOLON_BASLANGIC,SUTUN_BASLANGIC,SATIRNO, SUTUNNO,BASLIKALTISATIRNO
Public 	TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI, TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, DEGERLERSONSATIR , 	ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM, FASON_BASLIK_SATIR_KONUMU(50)
Public GIDEN_GELEN_BASLIK_KONUMU
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintForm()

	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	Set ddd = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	
	k.Visible = True

	SUTUN_BASLANGIC = 1
	SATIR_BASLANGIC  = 3
	
	Set TABLO = Doc.Select1("ABC","BOMU01T","BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE ='FASON-001 '","BOMREC_OPERASYON",-1)
	TABLO.Sort("BOMREC_OPERASYON")
	TABLO.GroupBy("BOMREC_OPERASYON")
	
 	Call DEGERLER (TABLO)
	
End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub BASLIKLAR ()

	'ARABASLIK KONUMU
	SATIR_ARA_BASLIK = SATIRNO
	SUTUN_ARA_BASLIK = SUTUNNO

	'SIRA NO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "S.NO"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC + 1

	'YARI MAMÜL RESMÝ
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Y.MAMUL RESMÝ"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'MAMÜL RESMÝ
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "MAMUL RESMÝ"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'ÖPS MAMUL KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "ÖPS MAMUL KODU"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'MÜÞTERÝ PARÇA KODU / ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "MÜÞTERÝ PARÇA KODU / ADI"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'FASON KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "FASON KODU"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'GÝDÝÞ DÖNÜÞ
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "GÝDÝÞ DÖNÜÞ"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'GÝDÝÞ DÖNÜÞ ÖPS PARÇA KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "GÝDÝÞ/DÖNÜÞ ÖPS PARÇA KODU"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'GÝDÝÞ DÖNÜÞ ÖPS PARÇA ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "GÝDÝÞ/DÖNÜÞ ÖPS PARÇA ADI"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	'FASONCU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "FASONCU"

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI = SUTUNNO	

		'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = SUTUN_ARA_BASLIK to 	TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI 
		Sheet.Cells(SATIR_ARA_BASLIK, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next

	ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM = SATIRNO
	
End Sub
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DEGERLER(TABLO)
	
	SATIRNO = SATIR_BASLANGIC
	SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	For t = 1 to TABLO.GETROWCOUNT
		'FASON ADINA GÖRE FÝLTRELEME
		QQQ = "BOMREC_OPERASYON='"+Doc.LeftJustify(TABLO.BOMREC_OPERASYON(t), 3)+"'"
		Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "BOMU01T", QQQ, "", -1)
		KayitSayisi = FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR.GetRowCount()
		FASONADI_X	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("IMLT01","AD",Trim(TABLO.BOMREC_OPERASYON(t)),"")
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FASON ADI BAÞLIK	
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASONADI_X
		FASON_BASLIK_SATIR_KONUMU(t) = SATIRNO 
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SAYAC = 0
		Call BASLIKLAR
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		For i=1 To KayitSayisi
			QQQ = "BOMREC_OPERASYON='"+Doc.LeftJustify(TABLO.BOMREC_OPERASYON(t), 3)+"'"
			Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "BOMU01T", QQQ, "", -1)
			FASONDAN_GELEN = FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR.BOMREC_YMAMULCODE(i)
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'SIRANO
			SAYAC = SAYAC + 1
			ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM  = ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM + 1
			Sheet.Cells(ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM, SUTUN_BASLANGIC).Value = SAYAC
			SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC + 1
			SATIRNO = ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
			'FASONA GÝDENÝN KODU
			QQQ = "EVRAKNO='"+Doc.LeftJustify(FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR.EVRAKNO(i), 10)+"'"
			Set FASONA_GIDEN_ICIN_TABLO = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "BOMU01T", QQQ, "", -1)
			FASONA_GIDEN = Trim(FASONA_GIDEN_ICIN_TABLO.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(1))
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'RESÝM EKLE
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
			STOKKODU_GIDEN = 	FASONA_GIDEN
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU_GIDEN & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				RESIM1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Top+8.5
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Left+4.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
    			k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 18
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 34
			End if
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU_GIDEN & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				If Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,1)="M" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="YM" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,3)="FYM" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HR" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HS" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HB" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HP" Then 
					RESIM1 	= Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", FASONDAN_GELEN +"000001", "EVRAKNO+SUBSRNUM"))
				Else
					RESIM1 	= Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", FASONDAN_GELEN +"000002", "EVRAKNO+SUBSRNUM"))
				End If
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Top+8.5	
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Left+4.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
	    		k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 18
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 34
			End if
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'OPS_PARCA_MAMUL_KODU
			If Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,1)	= "M" Then
				OPS_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","KOD",Trim(FASONDAN_GELEN),-1))
			Else
				OPS_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","TSENO",Trim(FASONDAN_GELEN),-1))
			End If
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "'" & OPS_PARCA_KODU 
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU
			MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",Trim(OPS_PARCA_KODU),-1))
			MUSTERI_PARCA_ADI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","NAME2",Trim(OPS_PARCA_KODU),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "'" & MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU & CHR(10) & "( " & MUSTERI_PARCA_ADI & " )" 
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASON KODU
			FASON_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_7",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASON_KODU
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASON GÝDÝÞ DÖNÜÞ BAÞLIK
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "GIDEN" & CHR(10) & "GELEN"
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASONA GÝDENÝN/GELEN KODU
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASONA_GIDEN & CHR(10) & FASONDAN_GELEN
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASONDAN GELENÝN KODU
			FASONA_GIDEN_AD = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			FASONDAN_GELEN_AD = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASONA_GIDEN_AD & CHR(10) & FASONDAN_GELEN_AD
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO +1
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASONCU
			If Left(Trim(FASON_KODU),2) = "K-" Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "KARAKAYA"
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_5",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			End If
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Nothing
		Next
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Nothing
	Next
	Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Nothing
	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO

	Call MAKYAJ (TABLO)

End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MAKYAJ(TABLO)

	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR - 1

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'LOGO MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(2, 2)).Merge
		'LOGO RESMÝ
	LOGO=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\opsLOGO.jpg"
	RTOPLOGO = Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Top+1
	RLEFTLOGO= Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Left+1
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set LOGORES = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(LOGO)) 
	RESIMLOGOADI=LOGORES.Name
	Sheet.Shapes(RESIMLOGOADI).Select
	LOGORES.Left = RLEFTLOGO 
	LOGORES.Top  = RTOPLOGO
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 25
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 50
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FORM BAÞLIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 3), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Value = "ÖZENPRES FASONA GÝDEN/GELEN PARÇA LÝSTESÝ"
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Select

	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 24

	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
'	For j = 2 To 2 
'		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4).Select
'		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
'		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
'		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
'		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
'		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
'	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 5 to 6' TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(4, i),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i)).Select
		k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'1. KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 4
		'2. KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(2).ColumnWidth = 8
		'3. KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(3).ColumnWidth = 8

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FASON BAÞLIKLARINI MERGE ve ORTALA
	For m = 1 To TABLO.GETROWCOUNT
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(FASON_BASLIK_SATIR_KONUMU(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(FASON_BASLIK_SATIR_KONUMU(m), TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Merge
		Sheet.Cells(FASON_BASLIK_SATIR_KONUMU(m), 1).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 8 '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR

		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SAYFA ADINI DEÐÝÞTÝRÝR
'------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = ""
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = ""
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.196850393700787)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 1
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 63
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$3"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

	For i = SUTUN_ARA_BASLIK to 	TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI 
		Sheet.Cells(SATIR_ARA_BASLIK, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next

	ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM = SATIRNO
	
End Sub
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DEGERLER(TABLO)
	
	SATIRNO = SATIR_BASLANGIC
	SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
	For t = 1 to TABLO.GETROWCOUNT
		'FASON ADINA GÖRE FÝLTRELEME
		QQQ = "BOMREC_OPERASYON='"+Doc.LeftJustify(TABLO.BOMREC_OPERASYON(t), 3)+"'"
		Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "BOMU01T", QQQ, "", -1)
		KayitSayisi = FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR.GetRowCount()
		FASONADI_X	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("IMLT01","AD",Trim(TABLO.BOMREC_OPERASYON(t)),"")
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FASON ADI BAÞLIK	
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASONADI_X
		FASON_BASLIK_SATIR_KONUMU(t) = SATIRNO 
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SAYAC = 0
		Call BASLIKLAR
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		For i=1 To KayitSayisi
			QQQ = "BOMREC_OPERASYON='"+Doc.LeftJustify(TABLO.BOMREC_OPERASYON(t), 3)+"'"
			Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "BOMU01T", QQQ, "", -1)
			FASONDAN_GELEN = FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR.BOMREC_YMAMULCODE(i)
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'SIRANO
			SAYAC = SAYAC + 1
			ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM  = ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM + 1
			Sheet.Cells(ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM, SUTUN_BASLANGIC).Value = SAYAC
			SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC + 1
			SATIRNO = ARA_BASLIK_ALTI_SATIR_KONUM
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------	
			'FASONA GÝDENÝN KODU
			QQQ = "EVRAKNO='"+Doc.LeftJustify(FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR.EVRAKNO(i), 10)+"'"
			Set FASONA_GIDEN_ICIN_TABLO = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "BOMU01T", QQQ, "", -1)
			FASONA_GIDEN = Trim(FASONA_GIDEN_ICIN_TABLO.BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE(1))
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'RESÝM EKLE
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
			STOKKODU_GIDEN = 	FASONA_GIDEN
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU_GIDEN & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				RESIM1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Top+8.5
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Left+4.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
    			k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 18
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 34
			End if
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU_GIDEN & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				If Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,1)="M" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="YM" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,3)="FYM" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HR" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HS" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HB" Or Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,2)="HP" Then 
					RESIM1 	= Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", FASONDAN_GELEN +"000001", "EVRAKNO+SUBSRNUM"))
				Else
					RESIM1 	= Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", FASONDAN_GELEN +"000002", "EVRAKNO+SUBSRNUM"))
				End If
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Top+8.5	
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Left+4.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
	    		k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 18
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 34
			End if
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'OPS_PARCA_MAMUL_KODU
			If Left(FASONDAN_GELEN,1)	= "M" Then
				OPS_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","KOD",Trim(FASONDAN_GELEN),-1))
			Else
				OPS_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","TSENO",Trim(FASONDAN_GELEN),-1))
			End If
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "'" & OPS_PARCA_KODU 
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU
			MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",Trim(OPS_PARCA_KODU),-1))
			MUSTERI_PARCA_ADI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","NAME2",Trim(OPS_PARCA_KODU),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "'" & MUSTERI_PARCA_KODU & CHR(10) & "( " & MUSTERI_PARCA_ADI & " )" 
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASON KODU
			FASON_KODU = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_7",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASON_KODU
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+1	
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASON GÝDÝÞ DÖNÜÞ BAÞLIK
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "GIDEN" & CHR(10) & "GELEN"
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASONA GÝDENÝN/GELEN KODU
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASONA_GIDEN & CHR(10) & FASONDAN_GELEN
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASONDAN GELENÝN KODU
			FASONA_GIDEN_AD = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			FASONDAN_GELEN_AD = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = FASONA_GIDEN_AD & CHR(10) & FASONDAN_GELEN_AD
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO +1
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'FASONCU
			If Left(Trim(FASON_KODU),2) = "K-" Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "KARAKAYA"
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_5",Trim(FASONA_GIDEN),-1))
			End If
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Nothing
		Next
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SUTUNNO = SUTUN_BASLANGIC
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Nothing
	Next
	Set FASON_OP_KODUNA_GORE_TABLOLAR = Nothing
	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO

	Call MAKYAJ (TABLO)

End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub MAKYAJ(TABLO)

	TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = DEGERLERSONSATIR - 1

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'LOGO MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1), Sheet.Cells(2, 2)).Merge
		'LOGO RESMÝ
	LOGO=Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "IMAGES\opsLOGO.jpg"
	RTOPLOGO = Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Top+1
	RLEFTLOGO= Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Left+1
	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set LOGORES = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(LOGO)) 
	RESIMLOGOADI=LOGORES.Name
	Sheet.Shapes(RESIMLOGOADI).Select
	LOGORES.Left = RLEFTLOGO 
	LOGORES.Top  = RTOPLOGO
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 25
	k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 50
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FORM BAÞLIK MERGE
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 3), Sheet.Cells(2, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Merge
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Value = "ÖZENPRES FASONA GÝDEN/GELEN PARÇA LÝSTESÝ"
	Sheet.Cells(1, 3).Select

	k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
	k.Selection.Font.Size = 24

	k.Selection.WrapText = True 
	k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
'	For j = 2 To 2 
'		Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI-4).Select
'		k.Selection.NumberFormat = "@"
'		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
'		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
'		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
'		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
'	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'IZGARA ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1		'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
	k.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
	k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'DÝKEY ORTALAMA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 to TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI
		Sheet.Columns(i).Select		
		k.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Sheet.Columns(i).EntireColumn.AutoFit
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'KOLONA SAÐ DÝK ÇÝZGÝ KALIN
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	For i = 5 to 6' TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI Step 2
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(4, i),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, i)).Select
		k.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		k.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 4  		'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'1. KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(1).ColumnWidth = 4
		'2. KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(2).ColumnWidth = 8
		'3. KOLON GENÝÞLÝÐÝ
	k.Columns(3).ColumnWidth = 8

'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'FASON BAÞLIKLARINI MERGE ve ORTALA
	For m = 1 To TABLO.GETROWCOUNT
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(FASON_BASLIK_SATIR_KONUMU(m), 1), Sheet.Cells(FASON_BASLIK_SATIR_KONUMU(m), TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Merge
		Sheet.Cells(FASON_BASLIK_SATIR_KONUMU(m), 1).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 12
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 8 '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR

		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
	Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SAYFA ADINI DEÐÝÞTÝRÝR
'------------------ ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Select() 
	Wb.Sheets(Sheet.Name).Name = "Termin_" & FORMTARIHI
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Call Yaziciya_Yazdir ()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
	k.Visible = True

	Sheet.Cells(1, 1).Select
	Set Sheet = Nothing
	Set wb = Nothing
	Set k = Nothing

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,TOPLAM_SUTUN_SAYISI)).Select
	k.Selection.Name = "DATALAR" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"DATALAR"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
   	.LeftHeader = ""
   	.CenterHeader = ""
   	.RightHeader = ""
  		.LeftFooter = ""
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
  		.RightFooter = ""
		.LeftMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .RightMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .TopMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.118110236220472)
     .BottomMargin = k.InchesToPoints(0.196850393700787)
     .HeaderMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
     .FooterMargin = k.InchesToPoints(3.93700787401575E-02)
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = True
		.Orientation = 1
		.Draft = False
		.Zoom = 63
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$3"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""
	End With

End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : FORD-02
Hangi Tablo için : STOK60
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : Ford Kasa Etiketi
Kod : 
Public Ust, EtiketBoyu, UstMargin,KonteynerKodu, Solmargin, sagMargin, EtiketNo, Unvan, Adres, UreticiKodu, Grade, S60T, Miktar, Lokasyon,STOKKODU

Sub PrintLabel()
	if trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE) = "D1D4F" Then
		QStr = "SEVK_EDILEN_FB='"+trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE)+"'&MUSTERIKODU='"+STOK60E.CH_KODU+"'&TARIH='"+Doc.BuGun+"'"
		Set OSP1L = Doc.Select1("XXX", "OTOSP1L", QStr, "", -1)
		if OSP1L.GetRowCount = 0 Then
			QStr = "SEVK_EDILEN_FB='"+trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE)+"'&MUSTERIKODU='"+STOK60E.CH_KODU+"'&TARIH='"+Doc.StrDate_Increment(Doc.BuGun,-1)+"'"
			Set OSP1L = Doc.Select1("XXX", "OTOSP1L", QStr, "", -1)
			if OSP1L.GetRowCount = 0 Then
				k = Doc.d7msgBox("Gölcük etiket iþlemleri için sevkiyat günü FOSN programý alýnmýþ olmaldýr.","dinamo",MB_OK)
				exit sub
			End if
		End if
	End if

	UreticiKodu = "AS3WA"
	Unvan = "ÖZEN PRES MAK.SAN.LTD.ÞTÝ."
	Adres = "TAYSAD ORG.SAN.BÖL.1.CD.16.YOL 6.PARSEL 41410 Þ.PINAR-GEBZE/KOCAELÝ"
'	Grade = "B"
	Set S60T = Doc.Select2("YYYY", "STOK60T", "FATURASIZMI<>'E'", "", -1)
	S60T.GroupBy2("KOD")
	Hata = ""
	for i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		stokKodu = S60T.KOD(i)
		Lokasyon = GetFordLokasyon(StokKodu)
		CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU
		CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)

'MUSTAFA				

			'AMBALAJKODU
		KonteynerKodu = Trim(GETKASAKODU(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI))
		KonteynerKodu = Trim(Mid(Trim(KonteynerKodu),5,8))

	'	KonteynerKodu = Doc.GetdbFieldValue("STOK00","TEXT_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
		if trim(KonteynerKodu) = "" Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " konteyner kodu girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if

'MUSTAFA

			'AMBALAJ MIKTARI
		STANDARTMIKTAR = GetStdKoliAdet(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)
		KUTUICIMIKTAR = STANDARTMIKTAR

	'	KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
	'	KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)

		if KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
			Hata = Hata & i & ". satýr " & stokKodu & " sandýk içi miktar girilmemiþ." & vbcrlf
		End if
	Next
	if trim(Hata) <> "" then
		k = doc.d7MsgBox(Hata & vbcrlf & "Ýþlem tamamlanmadan kesilmiþtir.","dinamo",MB_OK)
'		exit sub
	end if

	SevkAdresKodu = STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE
	if trim(SevkAdresKodu) = "" then
		k = Doc.d7msgBox("Sevk adres kodu girilmemiþ","dinamo",MB_OK)
		exit sub
	end if

	set pe1 = Doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	EtiketNo = 0
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210
	Ustmargin = 18
	EtiketBoyu = 117
	EtiketEni = 171
	EtiketlerArasi = 143
	res = pe1.Open(0,"Etiket" & trim(STOK60E.EVRAKNO),sayfaBoyu,sayfaEni,"")
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAlignment(2)
	res = pe1.SetBarcodeAutoCheckSum(0)

	solMargin = 10
	sagMargin = sayfaEni - 9
	CHKodu = STOK60E.CH_KODU

	For i = 1 to S60T.GetRecCount()
		Miktar = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)	
		if trim(S60T.KOD(i)) <> "" and Miktar > 0 then
			StokKodu = S60T.KOD(i)
			CHStokKodu = Doc.GetCHStokKodu(StokKodu,CHKodu)

'MUSTAFA

		'AMBALAJ MIKTARI
			STANDARTMIKTAR = GetStdKoliAdet(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)
			KUTUICIMIKTAR = STANDARTMIKTAR 

		'	KutuIciMiktar = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("STOK00","B_B_TECH_1",StokKodu,"")
		'	KutuIciMiktar = doc.Round(KutuIciMiktar,0)

			if KutuIciMiktar = 0 Then
				EtiketAdedi = S60T.SF_MIKTAR(i)
			Else
				EtiketAdedi = Doc.Ceil(Miktar / KutuIciMiktar)
			end if

' ZZZ

			for j = 1 to EtiketAdedi
				Kalan = Miktar - (j-1) * KutuIciMiktar
				if Kalan < KutuIciMiktar then
					KutuMiktari = Kalan
				else
					KutuMiktari = KutuIciMiktar
				end if

				EtiketNo = EtiketNo + 1

				ModEtiketNo = EtiketNo
		
'				if ModEtiketNo mod 2 = 1 then
					Ust = UstMargin						
						if EtiketNo <> 1 then
							res = pe1.PageBreak()
						end if
'					else
'						Ust = UstMargin + EtiketlerArasi
'				end if					
				Call Etiket(pe1,i, KutuMiktari)

			Next
		End if
	Next
	Doc.DeleteTableObject "YYYY"
	res = pe1.Show()
	Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Etiket(pe1,satirNo, KutuMiktari)
' dikey çizgilerin yerleri
	D1 = SolMargin + 47
	D2 = SolMargin + 87
	D3 = SolMargin + 121.5
	D4 = SolMargin + 125.5
	D5 = SolMargin + 139
	D6 = SolMargin + 158

'yatay çizgilerin yerleri
	Y1 = Ust + 12.5
	Y2 = Ust + 24
	Y3 = Ust + 35
	Y4 = Ust + 45.5
	Y5 = Ust + 56
	Y6 = Ust + 66
	Y7 = Ust + 79
	Y8 = Ust + 88
	Y9 = Ust + 98
	Y10 = Ust + 117

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Box(Ust,SolMargin, EtiketBoyu, sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y1,SolMargin,0,sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y2,D2,0,sagMargin-D2)
	res = pe1.Line(Y3,SolMargin,0,sagMargin-SolMargin)
	res = pe1.Line(Y4,D5,0,sagMargin-D5)
	res = pe1.Line(Y5,SolMargin,0,sagMargin-SolMargin)

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function Barkodgenisligi(Kod)
	Barkodgenisligi = (Len(trim(cstr(Kod))) + 3) * 4.6
End Function
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GetFordLokasyon(StokKodu)
	QStr = "KOD='"+StokKodu+"'&SEVK_EDILEN_FB='"+trim(STOK60E.SHIPTOCODE)+"'&ACIKKAPALI='A'&MUSTERIKODU='"+STOK60E.CH_KODU+"'&TARIH='"+Doc.BuGun+"'"
	Set OSP1L = Doc.Select1("XXX", "OTOSP1L", QStr, "", -1)
	if OSP1L.GetRowCount = 0 Then
		GetFordLokasyon = ""
	Else
		GetFordLokasyon = OSP1L.LOKASYON(1)
	End if
	Doc.DeletetableObject "XXX"
End Function
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GETKASAKODU(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)

	QSTR = "EVRAKNO='" + STOKKODU

	If Trim(CHKODU) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & CH_KODU = '" + Trim(CHKODU)
	End if

	If Trim(SEVKADRESI) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & SHIPTOCODE = '" + Trim(SEVKADRESI)
	End if

	QSTR = QSTR + "'"
	Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", QSTR, "", -1)

	If S0A.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		GetKasaKodu = ""
	Else
		GetKasaKodu = Trim(S0A.AMBALAJKODU(1))
	End if

	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S0AKASA"

End Function
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Function GETSTDKOLIADET(STOKKODU, CHKODU, SEVKADRESI)

	QSTR = "EVRAKNO='" + STOKKODU

	If Trim(CHKODU) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & CH_KODU = '" + Trim(CHKODU)
	End if

	If Trim(SEVKADRESI) <> "" Then
		QSTR = QSTR + "' & SHIPTOCODE = '" + Trim(SEVKADRESI)
	End if

	QSTR = QSTR + "'"
	Set S0A = Doc.Select1("S0AKASA", "STOK0A", QSTR, "", -1)

	If S0A.GetRowCount() = 0 Then
		GetKasa = ""
	Else
		GetStdKoliAdet = Trim(S0A.SF_PAKETICERIGI(1))
	End if

	Doc.DeleteTableObject "S0AKASA"

End Function

Public sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, sonSatir, satirSonu
Public UstMargin, SolMargin, SagMargin, AltMargin, satiryuksekligi
Public siraNo, satirBaslangic, satirAra, SatirBitis



Sub PrintForm()
'formby mozan
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1

	' A4Yatay 1 ise sayfa yatay, 1 harici dikey sayfa boyutudur
	A4Yatay = 1
	If A4Yatay = "1" Then
		sayfaBoyu = 210
		sayfaEni = 297
	Else
		sayfaBoyu = 297
		sayfaEni = 210
	End If

	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 20 
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 20
	satiryuksekligi = 12

	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "ORNEK", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni,"")
	
	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If
	siraNo = 0        

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	
	'Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	'*************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.line(KUTUUSTU + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)

	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)

	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)
	res = pe1.line(pe1.GetBottom + satiryuksekligi, KUTUSOLU, 0, KUTUSAGI)

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)

'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

End Sub

'PROGRAM BY MUSTAFA ÖZAN _ 30.05.2008

Public k,OTSP,Sheet,OTSP1,GununTarihi,j,Wb,ddd,KAYITSAYISI,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI,KAYITSTARTSATIRI,KAYITSTARTKOLONU,TOPLAMSATIRSAYISI
Public SEVKKODUYAZILDI,GRID,BASLIKALTISATIRNO,KOLONBASLANGIC,GUNKOLONSAYISI,HAFTAKOLONSAYISI,AYKOLONSAYISI,DEGERLERSONSATIR 
Public GUNKOLONSONU,BASLIKBASLANGICSATIRNO,BASLIKBASLANGICKOLONNO,HAFTAKOLONSONU,AYKOLONSONU,SEVKSATIR_ARR(10)
Public SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO,SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO,KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO,BUGUNKOLONSONU,FORMTARIHI,TERMINSIPARISNO,SEVKKODSAYISI
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub PrintForm()

	Set k = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb = k.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb.ActiveSheet
	Set ddd = Doc.CreateSObject("d7Date")
	
	k.Visible = True
	
	k.ActiveWindow.Zoom = 80
	
	SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = 5
	SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO = 2

	KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO

	Call BASLIKLAR ()
	Call DEGERLER ()

End Sub
'--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub DEGERLER()

	Dim SEVKKODU_ARR(10),SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(10),SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(10),SATIRNO,SUTUNNO

	KAYITSTARTSATIRI = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	KAYITSTARTKOLONU = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO 

	SATIRNO = KAYITSTARTSATIRI 
	SUTUNNO = KAYITSTARTKOLONU 

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")
	TABLO.SafePack()
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIKLARI
	TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
	TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
	
	SEVKKODSAYISI = TABLO.GetRowCount()

	For u=1 To SEVKKODSAYISI
		Set TABLO= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
		Set ESKITABLO=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
		TABLO.COPYTABLE(ESKITABLO)	
		TABLO.Sort("FABRIKA_KODU")
		TABLO.GroupBy("FABRIKA_KODU")
		SEVKKODU_ARR(u) = TABLO.FABRIKA_KODU(u)
		FORMTARIHI = OTOSP1E.TARIH(1)
		FORMTARIHI = Doc.StrToNorDate(FORMTARIHI)
		FORMTARIHI = Replace(FORMTARIHI, "/","-")

		QQQ = "EVRAKNO='"+Doc.LeftJustify(OTOSP1E.EVRAKNO(1), 10)+"' & FABRIKA_KODU='"+SEVKKODU_ARR(u)+"'"
		Set SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u) = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "OTOSP1T", QQQ, "", -1)

		For i = 1 To SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			PUNTAMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_4",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1))
			If PUNTAMI <> "PUNTA" Then SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i) = ""
		Next

		SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).SafePack
		TERMINSIPARISNO = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).PROGRAM_NO(1)
		SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u) = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRowCount()
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIK
		SEVKFABRIKAADI	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","AD",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
		SEVKFABRIKAADI2	= Doc.GetDbFieldValue("SHPT00J","NAME2",SEVKKODU_ARR(u),"")
			'SEVK ADRES BAÞLIÐI YAZ
		SEVKSATIR_ARR(u) = SATIRNO-1
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, SUTUNNO-1).Value = Trim(SEVKKODU_ARR(u)) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI) & " - " & Trim(SEVKFABRIKAADI2) 
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO-1, 1), Sheet.cells(SATIRNO-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1

		For i = 1 To SEVKKODAGOREKAYITSAYISI_ARR(u)
			Doc.StatusBarMessage "SEVK KODU= " & SEVKKODU_ARR(u) & " - " & "KAYITLAR= " & i & " / " & SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetRecCount()
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i))
			MAMULADI	= Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i),-1))
			KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","GK_2",Trim(SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)),-1))
		
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = MAMULADI 
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = KAYNAKMONTAJTANIMI 
			If Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "" Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			For h=19 To 20 
				If h=20 Then SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1 
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(h,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next
			
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
			For v=KOLONBASLANGIC To GUNKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'HAFTALAR (8 HAFTA)
			For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'AYLAR (4 AY)
			For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
				If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i) <> 0 Then
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(v,0), i)
				Else
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
					Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
					k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
					k.Selection.WrapText = True
				End If
				SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
			Next

			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO+ 1

				'ASN KÜMÜLATÝF MÝKTAR
			If SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i) <> 0 Then
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).GetFieldValue(Grid(8,0), i)
			Else
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Select		
				k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 18 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
				k.Selection.WrapText = True
			End If
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

				'ÝMALAT GARANTÝSÝ
			Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = ""
			SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				'RESÝM EKLE
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------		
			STOKKODU = SEVKEGOREKAYITLAR(u).KOD(i)
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & STOKKODU & "'", "", -1)
			If S0P.GetRowCount() > 0 Then
				RESIM1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.FULLFILENAME1
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).RowHeight = Wb.Sheets(1).Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Rowheight*1.5
				RTOP = Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Top+1.5
				RLEFT= Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Left+1.5
				Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, 1).Select
				Set RESIM = Sheet.Pictures.Insert(Trim(RESIM1)) 
				RESIMADI=RESIM.Name
				Sheet.Shapes(RESIMADI).Select
    			RESIM.Left = RLEFT 
				RESIM.Top = RTOP
    			k.Selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Height = 20
  				k.Selection.ShapeRange.Width = 30
			End if
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
			SUTUNNO = 2
		Next
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			'ÝKÝ SATIRDA BÝR SATIRLARI BOYA
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		For j = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO-1 To SATIRNO Step 2
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(j, 1), Sheet.Cells(j, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
			k.Selection.Font.Italic = True
		Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI = SATIRNO-1
			'BUGÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, BUGUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, BUGUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'GÜN SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, GUNKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI, GUNKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'HAFTA SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, HAFTAKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,HAFTAKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1
			'AY SONU AYRAÇ
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO+1, AYKOLONSONU), Sheet.cells(SEVKLERARASITOPLAMSATIRSAYISI,AYKOLONSONU)).Select
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern = 1

		SATIRNO = SATIRNO + 1
		SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO = SATIRNO

			'SEVK BAÞLIKLARI KOPYALA
		If u < SEVKKODSAYISI Then 
			Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, 1), Sheet.cells(KOLONBASLIKLARISATIRNO, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
			k.Selection.Copy
			Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, 1).Select
			Sheet.Paste
		End If
	Next

	DEGERLERSONSATIR = SATIRNO - 1

	Call MAKYAJ

End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub BASLIKLAR ()

	Doc.CreateTableObject "XXX=OTOSP1T","TMPCOPY"
	Set TABLOX= Doc.GetTableObject("XXX")
	Set ESKITABLOX=DOC.GetTableObject("OTOSP1T")
	TABLOX.CopyTable(ESKITABLOX)
	GRID = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","OTOSP1T")

	SATIRNO = SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO 
	SUTUNNO = SEVKBASLIKKOLONNO

		'RESÝM
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO-1).Value = "Resim"
		'PARÇA KODU
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(16,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'PARÇA ADI
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = Trim(Grid(17,2))
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'KAYNAK - MONTAJ BÝLGÝSÝ
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(18,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(18,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "K-M" 
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'BUGÜN
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(19,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(19,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	BUGUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'YARI
	TARIH=LEFT(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(20,2)),8),6)
	ddd.SetDate(RIGHT(Trim(Grid(20,2)),8))
	GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 

	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
		'SEVK BAÞLIK
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "SEVK"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	KOLONBASLANGIC=21
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'BAÞLIKDAKÝ GÜN-HAFTA-AY KOLON SAYISINI BULMA
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜN
	For x=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(x,2),"Gün",1)>0 Then GUNKOLONSAYISI=x
	Next
		'HAFTA
	For y=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(y,2),"Hafta",1)>0 Then HAFTAKOLONSAYISI=y
	Next
		'AY
	For z=KOLONBASLANGIC To 50
		If InStr(1,Grid(z,2),"Ay",1)>0 Then AYKOLONSAYISI=z
	Next
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'GÜNLER (14 GÜN)
	For v=KOLONBASLANGIC to GUNKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		ddd.SetDate(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8))
		GUNADI=ddd.GetDOWStr()
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = GUNADI & "           " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next
			
	GUNKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'HAFTALAR(8 HAFTA)
	For v=GUNKOLONSAYISI+1 To HAFTAKOLONSAYISI
		TARIH=Left(Right(Trim(Grid(v,2)),8),6)
		KACINCIHAFTA = Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),4)
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = KACINCIHAFTA & "H        " & TARIH 
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	HAFTAKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

		'AYLAR (4 AY)
	For v=HAFTAKOLONSAYISI+1 To AYKOLONSAYISI
		YHARFINEKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), "y", 1)
		NOKTAYAKADAR=InStr(1,Grid(v,2), ".", 1)
		AYYAZ=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),YHARFINEKADAR))
		AYSAYISI=Trim(Left(Trim(Grid(v,2)),NOKTAYAKADAR-1))
		Select Case AYSAYISI
			Case "1" AY="Ocak"
			Case "2" AY="Þubat"
			Case "3" AY="Mart"
			Case "4" AY="Nisan"
			Case "5" AY="Mayýs"
			Case "6" AY="Haziran"
			Case "7" AY="Temmuz"
			Case "8" AY="Aðustos"
			Case "9" AY="Eylül"
			Case "10" AY="Ekim"
			Case "11" AY="Kasým"
			Case "12" AY="Aralýk"
		End Select				
		Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = AYYAZ & "            " & AY
		SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Next

	AYKOLONSONU=SUTUNNO
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value ="."
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1

	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Toplam           Sevk"
	SUTUNNO = SUTUNNO + 1
	Sheet.Cells(SATIRNO, SUTUNNO).Value = "Ýmalat Garantisi"

	TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = SUTUNNO
	BASLIKALTISATIRNO = SATIRNO+1
	
		'BAÞLIK BOYA
	For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
		Sheet.Cells(SEVKBASLIKSATIRNO, i).Select
		k.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		k.Selection.Font.Size = 9
		k.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
		k.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
		k.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
		k.Selection.WrapText = True 
		k.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
	Next
	
End Sub
