Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 16)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	AlanUzunlugu = SagMargin - SolMargin
	p = 122
	k = 20
	u = 19
		'ÖZENPRES LOGO
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If trim(logo) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin+2, SolMargin+0.5, 15, 46, logo, 114)
	End If
		'LOGO SOLU DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, pe1.GetRight, k, 0)
		'SÝPARÝÞ FORMU BAÞLIK
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, pe1.GetRight+0.5,8,	AlanUzunlugu - p+u,"SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 1, pe1.GetLeft ,8,AlanUzunlugu - p+u,"ozenpres@ozenpres.com")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		'SÝPARÝÞ FORMU BAÞLIK SAÐ DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, pe1.GetRight+0.5, k, 0)
		'ÖZENPRES ADRES BÖLÜMÜ
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+1, 	pe1.GetRight+0.5, 	satiryuksekligi-3, 	AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"TOSB-Taysad Org.San.Bölg.")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 	pe1.GetLeft, 	satiryuksekligi-3, 	AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"1.CAD - 16.YOL - 6.PARSEL")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 	pe1.GetLeft, 	satiryuksekligi-3,		AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"Çayýrova / GEBZE")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 	pe1.GetLeft,	satiryuksekligi-3, 	AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"Tel: 0262 658 12 00 Fax: 0262 658 12 09")
		'SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU ALT YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + k, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	SiparisNo = STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
	CHKodu = STOK46E.CH_KODU(1)
	CHAdi = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CHKodu,-1) 
	Adres1 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,-1) 
	Adres2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,-1) 
	Adres3 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,-1) 
	Tel = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","TELEFONNO_1",CHKodu,-1) 
	Faks = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","FAXNO",CHKodu,-1) 
	ilgili = STOK46E.SIPIALAN(1)

		'SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU ÝLK KUTU BÖLÜMÜ ALTI
	konum = pe1.GetBottom+2
	y = 2
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.Write(konum, SolMargin+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,	32,	"Tedarikçi Firma")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,102.5,": " & CHAdi)
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,28, "Sipariþ No")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,AlanUzunlugu - 166,": " & Trim(SiparisNo))
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+2, SolMargin+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,32,"Tel")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,33,": " & Tel)
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,11,"Faks")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,34,": " & Faks)
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+24, satiryuksekligi-y,28,"Sipariþ Tarihi")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,AlanUzunlugu - 166,": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46E.TARIH(1)))
	'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SÝPARÝÞ TARÝHÝ ALTI SATIR ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 2, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
	TEL_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	Sol = SolMargin + 0.5
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)

		'SIRA NO, MALZEME BAÞLIKLARI
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop+0.5, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi-1 , Baslik)
		BASLIK_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
		res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
		res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, pe1.getleft - 0.5, 113.5, 0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
		'SIRA NO ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(BASLIK_ALTI_KONUM+0.5, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom + 1

	'0 = SIRA NO
	'1 = MALZEME
	'2 = MÝKTAR
	'3 = BR.FÝYAT
	'4 = TUTAR
	'5 = BOS

	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1,satirNo, S46T)

'CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	Dim satirpozr
	If trim(S46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	ReDim xCizgi(6)
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'**********************************************************************************

	If sonSatir >= SATIRSONU Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		satiryuksekligi= satiryuksekligi-3.4
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + 7
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
'**********************************************************************************
	res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	satiryuksekligi = 5
		'DEÐERLER
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(S46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
				Degisken = SatirNo
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If	
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "KESÝN  TAHMÝNÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			If Degisken = "K" Then
				Degisken = "KESÝN"
			ElseIf Degisken = "T" Then
				Degisken = "TAHMÝNÝ"
			Else 
				Degisken = "SEÇÝLMEMÝÞ"
			End If
			res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
			'res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "BIRIM" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "PARA BÝRÝMÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖPS KODU" Then
			STOKKODU = Trim(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "MALZEME ADI" Then
			res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 7)
			Degisken_Ad2 = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","NAME2",STOKKODU ,-1))
			Degisken = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",STOKKODU ,-1)) & " - (" & Degisken_Ad2 & ")"
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			'satirpozr = satirpozr + 0.5
			satiryuksekligi = satiryuksekligi + 6
		End If
		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi 
		'xCizgi(i) = Sol - 2
		'ReDim Preserve xCizgi(i-1)
	Next		
				 
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)

	satirBitis = satirSonu
		'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin, AlanUzunlugu)
	CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	
	CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM = pe1.GetLeft
	CERCEVE_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetTop

		'KALEMLER ARASI YATAY SATIR ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	SATIR = 0

	For k = 1 To 16
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic - 1 + SATIR, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)
		SATIR = SATIR + 7
	Next
	KALEM_SATIR_SONU = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEM SATIR SONU YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(KALEM_SATIR_SONU, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
		'NOTLAR SATIRI BAÞLANGICI
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEMLER ARASI DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝLER
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	OdemeSekli1 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	OdemeSekli2 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	SEVKSEKLI = STOK46E.NAKLIYEKOSULLARI(1)
	Ondalik = Grid(4,6)
	Tutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat(Tutar,18, Ondalik)
	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVTutari  = Doc.NumFormat(KDVTutari , 18, Ondalik)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = Doc.NumFormat(KDVDahilTutar , 18,Ondalik)
	TeslimTarihi = doc.StrToNorDate(S46T.RTESTARIH(1))
	Satinalma = STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)
	sBaslangic = SatirBitis + 1
	sYuksekligi = 7
	'NOTLAR
	'****************************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC + 2, SolMargin + 2, 5, 20, "NOTLAR :")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM = pe1.GetRight 
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	Notlar1 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
	Notlar2 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
	Notlar3 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_3(1)
	Notlar4 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_4(1)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, 				NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "1- " & Notlar1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "2- " & Notlar2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5,	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "3- " & Notlar3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "4- " & Notlar4)
		'NOTLAR ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 1, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'NOTLARALTI KONUMU
	NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
	PozAciklama = pe1.GetBottom() + 1
	'rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","PO  "+STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))
	'Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")	
	'If rows > 4 And pe1.GetPageCount() = 1 Then msgbox "En fazla 4 satýr mesaj yazabilirsiniz"
	For i = 1 To rows
		If i > 4 Then Exit For
		Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i)
		'If trim(Mesaj) <> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr+SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(PozAciklama + (2 + i) * sYuksekligi, Solmargin + 2, 5,AlanUzunlugu - 4,Mesaj)		
	Next
	'****************************************************************************************************************
		'AÇIKLAMA - KTA DAN BÝLGÝLERÝ ALIYOR. 
	'******	**********************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM + 2, SolMargin + 2,5, 20, "ÖNEMLÝ")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	SATIRATLA = 0
	ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom + 1
	For n = 1 To 10
		ACIKLAMA_NOT(n) = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK46E", STOK46E.EVRAKNO, "OZELNOT" & n,0)
		res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.Write(ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC+SATIRATLA, pe1.GetLeft,4,187, "* " & ACIKLAMA_NOT(n) )
		SATIRATLA = SATIRATLA + 5.5
	Next
	'*****************************************************************************************************************
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 36, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ ALTI KONUM
	SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 32, "SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)	
		'ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 7.6
	sayfasay = 0
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 39.4
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 15 * SatirYuksekligi

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI=''" , "SRNUM", -1)

	Call Alanlar(S46T)

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	siraNo = 0        
	
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI=''" , "SRNUM", -1)
	
	satirSayisi = S46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i, S46T)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, S46T)

		'SAYFA SAYISI
	For ss = 1 To sayfasayisi
		pe1.GoToPage(ss)
		sayfasay = sayfasay + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM + 0.5, CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM + 55, 5, 70, sayfasay & " / " & sayfasayisi)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Alanlar(S46T)

	'STOK46T.SORT(">REV_RTESTARIH")
	ReDim Grid(6,7)

		'FIELD ALAN ADLARI
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "STATUS"
	Grid(6,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"

		'KOLON GENÝÞLÝKLERÝ
	Grid(0,1) = 10
	Grid(1,1) = 32
	Grid(2,1) = 61
	Grid(3,1) = 18
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 28

		'FIELD ADI - CUSTOM
	Grid(0,2) = "S.NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "ÖPS KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(4,2) = "BIRIM"
	Grid(5,2) = "ÖNGÖRÜ/KESÝN"
	Grid(6,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"

		'ALAN TEXT MI NUMBER MI 
	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "T"
	Grid(6,4) = "D"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	

	Grid(0,6) = 0
	dTutar = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM")
	dKDV = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVLERTOPLAM")
	dKDVDahil = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM")
	If dTutar > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dTutar
	End If

	If dKDV  > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDV 
	End If

	If dKDVDahil > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDVDahil
	End If
End Sub

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1,satirNo, S46T)

'CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	Dim satirpozr
	If trim(S46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	ReDim xCizgi(6)
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'**********************************************************************************

	If sonSatir >= SATIRSONU-7 Then
		
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + 7
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
'**********************************************************************************
	res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

		'DEÐERLER
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(S46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
				Degisken = satirNo
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If	
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖNGÖRÜ/KESÝN" Then
			If Degisken = "1" Then
				Degisken = "KESÝN"
			ElseIf Degisken = "2" Then
				Degisken = "ÖNGÖRÜ"
			Else 
				Degisken = "SEÇÝLMEMÝÞ"
			End If
			res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "BIRIM" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖPS KODU" Then
			STOKKODU = Trim(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "MALZEME ADI" Then
			Degisken = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",STOKKODU ,-1))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		End If

		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, 5, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi 
		'xCizgi(i) = Sol - 2
		'ReDim Preserve xCizgi(i-1)
	Next		
				 
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)

	satirBitis = satirSonu
		'dýþ çerçeve

	CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom

	CERCEVE_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetTop

	SATIR = 0

	Next
	KALEM_SATIR_SONU = pe1.GetBottom

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(KALEM_SATIR_SONU, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
		'NOTLAR SATIRI BAÞLANGICI
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEMLER ARASI DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝLER
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	'For i = 0 To 6
		'LineX = xCizgi(i)		
		'If i > 1 Then
			'res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, LineX, KALEM_SATIR_SONU-TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 0)
		'Else
			res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 20, KALEM_SATIR_SONU-TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 0)
			res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 52, KALEM_SATIR_SONU-TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 0)
			res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 113, KALEM_SATIR_SONU-TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 0)
			res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 131, KALEM_SATIR_SONU-TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 0)
			res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 142, KALEM_SATIR_SONU-TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 0)
			res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 172, KALEM_SATIR_SONU-TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 0)
		'End If
		'Next
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	OdemeSekli1 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)

	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM + 2, SolMargin + 2,5, 20, "ÖNEMLÝ")

	SATIRATLA = 0
	ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom + 1

	'*****************************************************************************************************************
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 36, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ ALTI KONUM

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 32, "SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN")

	'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 7.6
	sayfasay = 0
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 39.4
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 14 * SatirYuksekligi

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI=''" , "SRNUM", -1)

	Call Alanlar(S46T)

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	siraNo = 0        
	
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI=''" , "SRNUM", -1)
	
	'MSGBOX S46T.GetRecCount()

	satirSayisi = S46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i, S46T)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, S46T)

		'SAYFA SAYISI
	For ss = 1 To sayfasayisi
		pe1.GoToPage(ss)
		sayfasay = sayfasay + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM + 0.5, CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM + 55, 5, 70, sayfasay & " / " & sayfasayisi)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Alanlar(S46T)

	'STOK46T.SORT(">REV_RTESTARIH")
	ReDim Grid(6,7)

		'FIELD ALAN ADLARI
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "STATUS"
	Grid(6,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"

		'KOLON GENÝÞLÝKLERÝ
	Grid(0,1) = 10
	Grid(1,1) = 32
	Grid(2,1) = 61
	Grid(3,1) = 18
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 28

		'FIELD ADI - CUSTOM
	Grid(0,2) = "S.NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "ÖPS KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(4,2) = "BIRIM"
	Grid(5,2) = "ÖNGÖRÜ/KESÝN"
	Grid(6,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"

		'ALAN TEXT MI NUMBER MI 
	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "T"
	Grid(6,4) = "D"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	

	Grid(0,6) = 0
	dTutar = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM")
	dKDV = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVLERTOPLAM")
	dKDVDahil = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM")
	If dTutar > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dTutar
	End If

	If dKDV  > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDV 
	End If

	If dKDVDahil > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDVDahil
	End If
End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 16)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	AlanUzunlugu = SagMargin - SolMargin
	p = 122
	k = 20
	u = 19
		'ÖZENPRES LOGO
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If trim(logo) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin+2, SolMargin+0.5, 15, 46, logo, 114)
	End If
		'LOGO SOLU DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝ

	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, pe1.GetRight+0.5, k, 0)

	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 5, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
	TEL_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	Sol = SolMargin + 0.5
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)

		'SIRA NO ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom + 1

	'0 = SIRA NO
	'1 = MALZEME
	'2 = MÝKTAR
	'3 = BR.FÝYAT
	'4 = TUTAR
	'5 = BOS

	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo, S46T)

'CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	Dim satirpozr
	If trim(S46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	ReDim xCizgi(6)
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'**********************************************************************************
	If sonSatir >= SATIRSONU-7 Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + 7
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
'**********************************************************************************
	res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

		'DEÐERLER
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(S46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
				Degisken = satirNo
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If	
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖNGÖRÜ/KESÝN" Then
			If Degisken = "1" Then
				Degisken = "KESÝN"
			ElseIf Degisken = "2" Then
				Degisken = "ÖNGÖRÜ"
			Else 
				Degisken = "SEÇÝLMEMÝÞ"
			End If
			res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "BIRIM" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		End If

		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, 5, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi 
		'xCizgi(i) = Sol - 2
		'ReDim Preserve xCizgi(i-1)
	Next		
				 
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, S46T)

	satirBitis = satirSonu
		'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin, AlanUzunlugu)

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	SATIR = 0

	For k = 1 To 15
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic - 1 + SATIR, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)

	Next

	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEMLER ARASI DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝLER
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	'For i = 0 To 6
		'LineX = xCizgi(i)		
		'If i > 1 Then
			'res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, LineX, KALEM_SATIR_SONU-TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 0)
		'Else
			res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 20, KALEM_SATIR_SONU-TEL_ALTI_KONUM, 0)

		'End If
		'Next
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	OdemeSekli1 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	OdemeSekli2 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	SEVKSEKLI = STOK46E.NAKLIYEKOSULLARI(1)

	sBaslangic = SatirBitis + 1
	sYuksekligi = 7
	'NOTLAR
	'****************************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM = pe1.GetRight 
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

	Notlar4 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_4(1)

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "2- " & Notlar2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5,	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "3- " & Notlar3)

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 7.6
	sayfasay = 0
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 39.4
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 14 * SatirYuksekligi

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI=''" , "SRNUM", -1)

	Call Alanlar(S46T)

	If doc.ErrorNumber Then
		MsgBox ("Hata main : " & doc.ErrorNumber)
		Exit Sub
	End If

	siraNo = 0        
	
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI=''" , "SRNUM", -1)
	
	satirSayisi = S46T.GetRecCount()
	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i, S46T)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, S46T)

		'SAYFA SAYISI
	For ss = 1 To sayfasayisi
		pe1.GoToPage(ss)
		sayfasay = sayfasay + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM + 0.5, CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM + 55, 5, 70, sayfasay & " / " & sayfasayisi)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Alanlar(S46T)

	'STOK46T.SORT(">REV_RTESTARIH")
	ReDim Grid(6,7)

		'FIELD ALAN ADLARI
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "STATUS"
	Grid(6,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"

		'KOLON GENÝÞLÝKLERÝ
	Grid(0,1) = 10
	Grid(1,1) = 32
	Grid(2,1) = 61
	Grid(3,1) = 18
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 30
	Grid(6,1) = 28

		'FIELD ADI - CUSTOM
	Grid(0,2) = "S.NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "ÖPS KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(4,2) = "BIRIM"
	Grid(5,2) = "ÖNGÖRÜ/KESÝN"
	Grid(6,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"

		'ALAN TEXT MI NUMBER MI 
	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "T"
	Grid(6,4) = "D"

	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		If Grid(i,4)="N" Then
			Degisken = Grid(i,0)
			ondalik = S46T.MaxSigDig(Degisken)	
			Grid(i,6) = Ondalik		
		End If
	Next	

	Grid(0,6) = 0
	dTutar = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM")
	dKDV = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVLERTOPLAM")
	dKDVDahil = STOK46E.MaxSigDig("OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM")
	If dTutar > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dTutar
	End If

	If dKDV  > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDV 
	End If

	If dKDVDahil > Grid(4,6) Then
		Grid(4,6) = dKDVDahil
	End If
End Sub

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo, S46T)

'CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	Dim satirpozr
	If trim(S46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	ReDim xCizgi(6)
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'**********************************************************************************
	If sonSatir >= SATIRSONU-7 Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + 7
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
'**********************************************************************************
	res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")

		'DEÐERLER
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(S46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
				Degisken = satirNo
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If	
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")

		If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖNGÖRÜ/KESÝN" Then
			If Degisken = "1" Then
				Degisken = "KESÝN"
			ElseIf Degisken = "2" Then
				Degisken = "ÖNGÖRÜ"
			Else 
				Degisken = "SEÇÝLMEMÝÞ"
			End If
			res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "BIRIM" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖPS KODU" Then
			STOKKODU = Trim(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "MALZEME ADI" Then
			Degisken = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",STOKKODU ,-1))
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		End If

		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, 5, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi 
		'xCizgi(i) = Sol - 2
		'ReDim Preserve xCizgi(i-1)
	Next		
				 
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

End Sub

	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 1, OPS_ADINA_ONAYLAYAN_SOL_KONUM, 5, 45, "GENEL MÜDÜR")
		'FORM NUMARASI
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM + 0.5, CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM, 5, 50, "FR.07.04.08; Rev:02; 14.11.08")

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 7.6
	sayfasay = 0
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 39.4
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 15 * SatirYuksekligi

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI=''" , "SRNUM", -1)

	Call Alanlar(S46T)

	siraNo = 0        
	
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI=''" , "SRNUM", -1)
	'S46T.SORT("RTESTARIH")

	satirSayisi = S46T.GetRecCount()

	If satirSayisi = 0 Then
		Msgbox "Bu form sadece AÇIK SÝPARÝÞLER içindir !"
		Exit Sub
	End If

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i, S46T)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, S46T)

		'SAYFA SAYISI
	For ss = 1 To sayfasayisi
		pe1.GoToPage(ss)
		sayfasay = sayfasay + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM + 0.5, CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM + 55, 5, 70, sayfasay & " / " & sayfasayisi)
	Next
	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Alanlar(S46T)

	'STOK46T.SORT(">REV_RTESTARIH")
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

		'FIELD ALAN ADLARI
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "SPSTATUSU"
	Grid(6,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

		'KOLON GENÝÞLÝKLERÝ
	Grid(0,1) = 6
	Grid(1,1) = 32
	Grid(2,1) = 62
	Grid(3,1) = 17
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 16
	Grid(6,1) = 17
	Grid(7,1) = 18
	Grid(8,1) = 11

		'FIELD ADI - CUSTOM
	Grid(0,2) = "NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "ÖPS KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(4,2) = "BIRIM"
	Grid(5,2) = "KESÝN  TAHMÝNÝ"
	Grid(6,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(7,2) = "BÝRÝM FÝYAT"
	Grid(8,2) = "PARA BÝRÝMÝ"

		'ALAN TEXT MI NUMBER MI 
	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "T"
	Grid(6,4) = "D"
	Grid(7,4) = "T"
	Grid(8,4) = "T"

End Sub

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1,satirNo, S46T)

'CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	Dim satirpozr
	If trim(S46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	ReDim xCizgi(6)
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'**********************************************************************************

	If sonSatir >= SATIRSONU Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		satiryuksekligi= satiryuksekligi-3.4
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + 7
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
'**********************************************************************************
	res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	satiryuksekligi = 5
		'DEÐERLER
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(S46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
				Degisken = SatirNo
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If	
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "KESÝN  TAHMÝNÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			If Degisken = "K" Then
				Degisken = "KESÝN"
			ElseIf Degisken = "T" Then
				Degisken = "TAHMÝNÝ"
			Else 
				Degisken = "SEÇÝLMEMÝÞ"
			End If
			res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
			'res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "BIRIM" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "PARA BÝRÝMÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖPS KODU" Then
			STOKKODU = Trim(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "MALZEME ADI" Then
			res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 7)
			Degisken_Ad2 = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","NAME2",STOKKODU ,-1))
			Degisken = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",STOKKODU ,-1)) & " - (" & Degisken_Ad2 & ")"
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			'satirpozr = satirpozr + 0.5
			satiryuksekligi = satiryuksekligi + 6
		End If
		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi 
		'xCizgi(i) = Sol - 2
		'ReDim Preserve xCizgi(i-1)
	Next		
				 
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)

	satirBitis = satirSonu
		'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin, AlanUzunlugu)
	CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	
	CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM = pe1.GetLeft
	CERCEVE_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetTop

		'KALEMLER ARASI YATAY SATIR ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	SATIR = 0

	For k = 1 To 16
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic - 1 + SATIR, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)
		SATIR = SATIR + 7
	Next
	KALEM_SATIR_SONU = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEM SATIR SONU YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(KALEM_SATIR_SONU, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
		'NOTLAR SATIRI BAÞLANGICI
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEMLER ARASI DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝLER
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	OdemeSekli1 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	OdemeSekli2 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	SEVKSEKLI = STOK46E.NAKLIYEKOSULLARI(1)
	Ondalik = Grid(4,6)
	Tutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat(Tutar,18, Ondalik)
	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVTutari  = Doc.NumFormat(KDVTutari , 18, Ondalik)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = Doc.NumFormat(KDVDahilTutar , 18,Ondalik)
	TeslimTarihi = doc.StrToNorDate(S46T.RTESTARIH(1))
	Satinalma = STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)
	sBaslangic = SatirBitis + 1
	sYuksekligi = 7
	'NOTLAR
	'****************************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC + 2, SolMargin + 2, 5, 20, "NOTLAR :")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM = pe1.GetRight 
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	Notlar1 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
	Notlar2 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
	Notlar3 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_3(1)
	Notlar4 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_4(1)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, 				NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "1- " & Notlar1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "2- " & Notlar2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5,	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "3- " & Notlar3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "4- " & Notlar4)
		'NOTLAR ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 1, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'NOTLARALTI KONUMU
	NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
	PozAciklama = pe1.GetBottom() + 1
	'rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","PO  "+STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))
	'Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")	
	'If rows > 4 And pe1.GetPageCount() = 1 Then msgbox "En fazla 4 satýr mesaj yazabilirsiniz"
	For i = 1 To rows
		If i > 4 Then Exit For
		Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i)
		'If trim(Mesaj) <> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr+SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(PozAciklama + (2 + i) * sYuksekligi, Solmargin + 2, 5,AlanUzunlugu - 4,Mesaj)		
	Next
	'****************************************************************************************************************
		'AÇIKLAMA - KTA DAN BÝLGÝLERÝ ALIYOR. 
	'******	**********************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM + 2, SolMargin + 2,5, 20, "ÖNEMLÝ")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	SATIRATLA = 0
	ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom + 1

	Next
	'*****************************************************************************************************************
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 36, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)

	SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom

	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 32, "SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

	'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)	
		'ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 45, "ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN")

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 7.6
	sayfasay = 0
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 39.4
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 15 * SatirYuksekligi

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI<>'herhangi'" , "SRNUM", -1)
	
	Call Alanlar(S46T)

	siraNo = 0        
	
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI<>'herhangi'" , "SRNUM", -1)
	'S46T.SORT("RTESTARIH")

	satirSayisi = S46T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i, S46T)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, S46T)

		'SAYFA SAYISI
	For ss = 1 To sayfasayisi
		pe1.GoToPage(ss)
		sayfasay = sayfasay + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM + 0.5, CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM + 55, 5, 70, sayfasay & " / " & sayfasayisi)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub

Sub Alanlar(S46T)

	'STOK46T.SORT(">REV_RTESTARIH")
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

		'FIELD ALAN ADLARI
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "SPSTATUSU"
	Grid(6,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

		'KOLON GENÝÞLÝKLERÝ
	Grid(0,1) = 6
	Grid(1,1) = 32
	Grid(2,1) = 62
	Grid(3,1) = 17
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 16
	Grid(6,1) = 17
	Grid(7,1) = 18
	Grid(8,1) = 11

		'FIELD ADI - CUSTOM
	Grid(0,2) = "NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "ÖPS KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(4,2) = "BIRIM"
	Grid(5,2) = "KESÝN  TAHMÝNÝ"
	Grid(6,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(7,2) = "BÝRÝM FÝYAT"
	Grid(8,2) = "PARA BÝRÝMÝ"

		'ALAN TEXT MI NUMBER MI 
	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "T"
	Grid(6,4) = "D"
	Grid(7,4) = "T"
	Grid(8,4) = "T"

End Sub

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1,satirNo, S46T)

'CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	Dim satirpozr
	If trim(S46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	ReDim xCizgi(6)
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'**********************************************************************************

	If sonSatir >= SATIRSONU Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		satiryuksekligi= satiryuksekligi-3.4
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + 7
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
'**********************************************************************************
	res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	satiryuksekligi = 5
		'DEÐERLER
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(S46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
				Degisken = SatirNo
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If	
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "KESÝN  TAHMÝNÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			If Degisken = "K" Then
				Degisken = "KESÝN"
			ElseIf Degisken = "T" Then
				Degisken = "TAHMÝNÝ"
			Else 
				Degisken = "SEÇÝLMEMÝÞ"
			End If
			res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
			'res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "BIRIM" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "PARA BÝRÝMÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖPS KODU" Then
			STOKKODU = Trim(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "MALZEME ADI" Then
			res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 7)
			Degisken_Ad2 = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","NAME2",STOKKODU ,-1))
			Degisken = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",STOKKODU ,-1)) & " - (" & Degisken_Ad2 & ")"
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			'satirpozr = satirpozr + 0.5
			satiryuksekligi = satiryuksekligi + 6
		End If
		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi 
		'xCizgi(i) = Sol - 2
		'ReDim Preserve xCizgi(i-1)
	Next		
				 
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)

	satirBitis = satirSonu
		'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin, AlanUzunlugu)
	CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	
	CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM = pe1.GetLeft
	CERCEVE_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetTop

		'KALEMLER ARASI YATAY SATIR ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	SATIR = 0

	For k = 1 To 16
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic - 1 + SATIR, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)
		SATIR = SATIR + 7
	Next
	KALEM_SATIR_SONU = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEM SATIR SONU YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(KALEM_SATIR_SONU, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
		'NOTLAR SATIRI BAÞLANGICI
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEMLER ARASI DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝLER
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	OdemeSekli1 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	OdemeSekli2 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	SEVKSEKLI = STOK46E.NAKLIYEKOSULLARI(1)
	Ondalik = Grid(4,6)
	Tutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat(Tutar,18, Ondalik)
	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVTutari  = Doc.NumFormat(KDVTutari , 18, Ondalik)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = Doc.NumFormat(KDVDahilTutar , 18,Ondalik)
	TeslimTarihi = doc.StrToNorDate(S46T.RTESTARIH(1))
	Satinalma = STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)
	sBaslangic = SatirBitis + 1
	sYuksekligi = 7
	'NOTLAR
	'****************************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC + 2, SolMargin + 2, 5, 20, "NOTLAR :")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM = pe1.GetRight 
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	Notlar1 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
	Notlar2 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
	Notlar3 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_3(1)
	Notlar4 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_4(1)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, 				NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "1- " & Notlar1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "2- " & Notlar2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5,	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "3- " & Notlar3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "4- " & Notlar4)
		'NOTLAR ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 1, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'NOTLARALTI KONUMU
	NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
	PozAciklama = pe1.GetBottom() + 1
	'rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","PO  "+STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))
	'Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")	
	'If rows > 4 And pe1.GetPageCount() = 1 Then msgbox "En fazla 4 satýr mesaj yazabilirsiniz"
	For i = 1 To rows
		If i > 4 Then Exit For
		Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i)
		'If trim(Mesaj) <> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr+SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(PozAciklama + (2 + i) * sYuksekligi, Solmargin + 2, 5,AlanUzunlugu - 4,Mesaj)		
	Next
	'****************************************************************************************************************
		'AÇIKLAMA - KTA DAN BÝLGÝLERÝ ALIYOR. 
	'******	**********************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM + 2, SolMargin + 2,5, 20, "ÖNEMLÝ")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	SATIRATLA = 0
	ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom + 1
	For n = 1 To 10
		ACIKLAMA_NOT(n) = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK46E", STOK46E.EVRAKNO, "OZELNOT" & n,0)
		res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)
		res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
		res = pe1.Write(ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC+SATIRATLA, pe1.GetLeft,4,187, "* " & ACIKLAMA_NOT(n) )
		SATIRATLA = SATIRATLA + 5.5
	Next
	'*****************************************************************************************************************
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 36, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ ALTI KONUM
	SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 32, "SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)	
		'ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 45, "ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	OPS_ADINA_ONAYLAYAN_SOL_KONUM = pe1.GetLeft
		'ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN  SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)	
		'SEVK ÞEKLÝ
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 36, "SEVK ÞEKLÝ")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 2, pe1.GetLeft, 25 , 36, SEVKSEKLI)
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",9)
		'SEVK ÞEKLÝ  SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)	
		'ÖDEME
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 20, "ÖDEME")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 2, pe1.GetLeft, 5 , 20, OdemeSekli1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 1, pe1.GetLeft, 5 , 20, OdemeSekli2)
		'ÖDEME SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)	
		'LÜTFEN TEYÝT EDÝNÝZ
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM+0.3, pe1.GetLeft, 6.7, 51, "")
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(255,255,255))
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",12)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 47, "LÜTFEN TEYÝT EDÝNÝZ")
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTextColor(RGB(0,0,0))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ALT YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 1, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
		'GENEL MÜDÜR

	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 1, OPS_ADINA_ONAYLAYAN_SOL_KONUM, 5, 45, "GENEL MÜDÜR")
		'FORM NUMARASI
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial", 9)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM + 0.5, CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM, 5, 50, "FR.07.04.08; Rev:02; 14.11.08")

	res = pe1.PenSize(0.3)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)

End Sub
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub

Public sayfaTuru, sayfaBoyu, sayfaEni, basla, bitir, sonSatir, satirSonu, ToplamEn , BasilabilirAlan

Sub PrintForm()
	Dim satirSayisi,pe1
	sayfaBoyu = 297
	sayfaEni = 210

	ToplamTutar = 0
	ToplamProTutar = 0
	siraNo = 0
	satirBaslangic = 0
	UstMargin = 10
	AltMargin = SayfaBoyu - 10
	SolMargin = 10
	SagMargin = SayfaEni - 10
	satiryuksekligi = 7.6
	sayfasay = 0
	satirBaslangic = UstMargin + 39.4
	satirSonu = satirBaslangic + 15 * SatirYuksekligi

	
	Set pe1 = doc.CreatePrintEngineOutput()
	res = pe1.Open(0, "Satýnalma Sipariþi", SayfaBoyu, SayfaEni, "")
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI<>'herhangi'" , "SRNUM", -1)
	
	Call Alanlar(S46T)

	siraNo = 0        
	
	Set S46T = Doc.Select1("sdfsfsf", "STOK46T", "EVRAKNO='" + STOK46E.EVRAKNO + "' & ACIKKAPALI<>'herhangi'" , "SRNUM", -1)
	'S46T.SORT("RTESTARIH")

	satirSayisi = S46T.GetRecCount()

	Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)

	For i = 1 To satirSayisi
		Call Print_form_satir(pe1, i, S46T)
	Next
		
	Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1, S46T)

		'SAYFA SAYISI
	For ss = 1 To sayfasayisi
		pe1.GoToPage(ss)
		sayfasay = sayfasay + 1
		res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
		res = pe1.Write(CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM + 0.5, CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM + 55, 5, 70, sayfasay & " / " & sayfasayisi)
	Next

	res = pe1.Show()
	res = Doc.ActivateAfterMacro(1)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Alanlar(S46T)

	'STOK46T.SORT(">REV_RTESTARIH")
	ReDim Grid(9,7)

		'FIELD ALAN ADLARI
	Grid(0,0) = "_POS"
	Grid(1,0) = "KOD"
	Grid(2,0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"
	Grid(3,0) = "SF_MIKTAR"
	Grid(4,0) = "SF_SF_UNIT"
	Grid(5,0) = "SPSTATUSU"
	Grid(6,0) = "REV_RTESTARIH"
	Grid(7,0) = "OR_FIYAT"
	Grid(8,0) = "PRICEUNIT"

		'KOLON GENÝÞLÝKLERÝ
	Grid(0,1) = 6
	Grid(1,1) = 32
	Grid(2,1) = 62
	Grid(3,1) = 17
	Grid(4,1) = 11
	Grid(5,1) = 16
	Grid(6,1) = 17
	Grid(7,1) = 18
	Grid(8,1) = 11

		'FIELD ADI - CUSTOM
	Grid(0,2) = "NO"
	Grid(1,2) = "ÖPS KODU"
	Grid(2,2) = "MALZEME ADI"
	Grid(3,2) = "MÝKTAR"
	Grid(4,2) = "BIRIM"
	Grid(5,2) = "KESÝN  TAHMÝNÝ"
	Grid(6,2) = "TESLÝM TARÝHÝ"
	Grid(7,2) = "BÝRÝM FÝYAT"
	Grid(8,2) = "PARA BÝRÝMÝ"

		'ALAN TEXT MI NUMBER MI 
	Grid(0,4) = "N"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"
	Grid(4,4) = "C"
	Grid(5,4) = "T"
	Grid(6,4) = "D"
	Grid(7,4) = "T"
	Grid(8,4) = "T"

End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
	res = pe1.nopen()
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 16)
	res = pe1.setalign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)

	AlanUzunlugu = SagMargin - SolMargin
	p = 122
	k = 20
	u = 19
		'ÖZENPRES LOGO
	res = pe1.NoPen()
	logo = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm() & trim(Doc.Customp_Gets("!LOGO"))
	If trim(logo) <> "" Then
		res = pe1.Picture(UstMargin+2, SolMargin+0.5, 15, 46, logo, 114)
	End If
		'LOGO SOLU DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, pe1.GetRight, k, 0)
		'SÝPARÝÞ FORMU BAÞLIK
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin + 2, pe1.GetRight+0.5,8,	AlanUzunlugu - p+u,"SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU")
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom + 1, pe1.GetLeft ,8,AlanUzunlugu - p+u,"ozenpres@ozenpres.com")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		'SÝPARÝÞ FORMU BAÞLIK SAÐ DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin, pe1.GetRight+0.5, k, 0)
		'ÖZENPRES ADRES BÖLÜMÜ
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.Write(UstMargin+1, 	pe1.GetRight+0.5, 	satiryuksekligi-3, 	AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"TOSB-Taysad Org.San.Bölg.")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 	pe1.GetLeft, 	satiryuksekligi-3, 	AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"1.CAD - 16.YOL - 6.PARSEL")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 	pe1.GetLeft, 	satiryuksekligi-3,		AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"Çayýrova / GEBZE")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom, 	pe1.GetLeft,	satiryuksekligi-3, 	AlanUzunlugu - p-0.5,	"Tel: 0262 658 12 00 Fax: 0262 658 12 09")
		'SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU ALT YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(UstMargin + k, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		

	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)		
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)

	SiparisNo = STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)
	Tarih = doc.StrtoNordate(STOK46E.TARIH(1))
	CHKodu = STOK46E.CH_KODU(1)
	CHAdi = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","AD",CHKodu,-1) 
	Adres1 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_1",CHKodu,-1) 
	Adres2 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_2",CHKodu,-1) 
	Adres3 = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","ADRES_3",CHKodu,-1) 
	Tel = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","TELEFONNO_1",CHKodu,-1) 
	Faks = doc.GetKartValue("CARI00","FAXNO",CHKodu,-1) 
	ilgili = STOK46E.SIPIALAN(1)

		'SATINALMA SÝPARÝÞ FORMU ÝLK KUTU BÖLÜMÜ ALTI
	konum = pe1.GetBottom+2
	y = 2
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 12)
	res = pe1.Write(konum, SolMargin+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,	32,	"Tedarikçi Firma")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,102.5,": " & CHAdi)
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,28, "Sipariþ No")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,AlanUzunlugu - 166,": " & Trim(SiparisNo))
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.setalign("RIGHT")
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+2, SolMargin+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,32,"Tel")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,33,": " & Tel)
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,11,"Faks")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,34,": " & Faks)
	'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+24, satiryuksekligi-y,28,"Sipariþ Tarihi")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, pe1.GetRight+0.5, satiryuksekligi-y,AlanUzunlugu - 166,": " & Doc.StrToNorDate(STOK46E.TARIH(1)))
	'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'SÝPARÝÞ TARÝHÝ ALTI SATIR ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 2, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
	TEL_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	Sol = SolMargin + 0.5
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.selectfont("Arial",9)

		'SIRA NO, MALZEME BAÞLIKLARI
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1)
		Baslik = Grid(i,2)
		res = pe1.write(pe1.GetTop+0.5, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi-1 , Baslik)
		BASLIK_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
		res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
		res = pe1.Line(TEL_ALTI_KONUM, pe1.getleft - 0.5, 113.5, 0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
	Next
	
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
		'SIRA NO ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(BASLIK_ALTI_KONUM+0.5, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
	satirBaslangic = pe1.GetBottom + 1

	'0 = SIRA NO
	'1 = MALZEME
	'2 = MÝKTAR
	'3 = BR.FÝYAT
	'4 = TUTAR
	'5 = BOS

	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.pensize(0.5)
	Call Normal(pe1)
End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Print_form_satir(pe1,satirNo, S46T)

'CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)

	Dim satirpozr
	If trim(S46T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
	ReDim xCizgi(6)
	Degisken = ""
	sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
'**********************************************************************************

	If sonSatir >= SATIRSONU Then
		Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)
		siraNo = 1
		res = pe1.PageBreak()
		satiryuksekligi= satiryuksekligi-3.4
		Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		sayfaSayisi = pe1.GetPageCount()
	Else
		If satirNo = 1 Then
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		Else
			satirpozr = pe1.GetTop() + 7
		End If
		siraNo = siraNo + 1
	End If		
'**********************************************************************************
	res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
	res = pe1.setbold(0)
	Sol = SolMargin + 2
	res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
	satiryuksekligi = 5
		'DEÐERLER
	For i=0 To UBound(Grid,1)
		SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
		DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
		res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 9)
		If left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = trim(cstr(S46T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)))
		Else
			If DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
				Degisken = SatirNo
			Else
				Degisken = ""
			End If
		End If	
		res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		
		If Grid(i,4) = "N" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
			Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
			Degisken = Doc.NumFormat(Degisken, 18,Ondalik)
		ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" And left(DegiskenAdi,1)<> "_" Then
			Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf DegiskenAdi = "_POS" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "KESÝN  TAHMÝNÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			If Degisken = "K" Then
				Degisken = "KESÝN"
			ElseIf Degisken = "T" Then
				Degisken = "TAHMÝNÝ"
			Else 
				Degisken = "SEÇÝLMEMÝÞ"
			End If
			res = pe1.SetItalic(1)
			'res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "BIRIM" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "PARA BÝRÝMÝ" Then
			res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "ÖPS KODU" Then
			STOKKODU = Trim(Degisken)
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
		ElseIf Grid(i,2)= "MALZEME ADI" Then
			res = pe1.selectfont("Times New Roman", 7)
			Degisken_Ad2 = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","NAME2",STOKKODU ,-1))
			Degisken = Trim(Doc.GetKartValue("STOK00","AD",STOKKODU ,-1)) & " - (" & Degisken_Ad2 & ")"
			res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
			'satirpozr = satirpozr + 0.5
			satiryuksekligi = satiryuksekligi + 6
		End If
		
		res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol-1, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
		res = pe1.SetItalic(0)
		Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi 
		'xCizgi(i) = Sol - 2
		'ReDim Preserve xCizgi(i-1)
	Next		
				 
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)

End Sub

Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1,S46T)

	satirBitis = satirSonu
		'dýþ çerçeve
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.box(UstMargin, SolMargin, AltMargin - UstMargin, AlanUzunlugu)
	CERCEVE_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom	
	CERCEVE_SOL_KONUM = pe1.GetLeft
	CERCEVE_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetTop

		'KALEMLER ARASI YATAY SATIR ÇÝZGÝLERÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	SATIR = 0

	For k = 1 To 16
		res = pe1.line(satirBaslangic - 1 + SATIR, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)
		SATIR = SATIR + 7
	Next
	KALEM_SATIR_SONU = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEM SATIR SONU YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(KALEM_SATIR_SONU, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)	
		'NOTLAR SATIRI BAÞLANGICI
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom
		'KALEMLER ARASI DÝKEY ÇÝZGÝLER
	res = pe1.pensize(0.1)
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	OdemeSekli1 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_1(1)
	OdemeSekli2 = STOK46E.ODEMEKOSULLARI_2(1)
	SEVKSEKLI = STOK46E.NAKLIYEKOSULLARI(1)
	Ondalik = Grid(4,6)
	Tutar = STOK46E.OR_ISKONTOLUTOPLAM(1)
	Tutar = Doc.NumFormat(Tutar,18, Ondalik)
	KDVTutari = STOK46E.OR_KDVLERTOPLAM(1)
	KDVTutari  = Doc.NumFormat(KDVTutari , 18, Ondalik)
	KDVDahilTutar = STOK46E.OR_KDVDAHILTOPLAM(1)
	KDVDahilTutar = Doc.NumFormat(KDVDahilTutar , 18,Ondalik)
	TeslimTarihi = doc.StrToNorDate(S46T.RTESTARIH(1))
	Satinalma = STOK46E.SIPIVEREN(1)
	sBaslangic = SatirBitis + 1
	sYuksekligi = 7
	'NOTLAR
	'****************************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SelectFont("Arial",10)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC + 2, SolMargin + 2, 5, 20, "NOTLAR :")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM = pe1.GetRight 
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	Notlar1 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_1(1)
	Notlar2 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_2(1)
	Notlar3 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_3(1)
	Notlar4 = STOK46E.SIPLEILGILINOTLAR_4(1)
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetTop, 				NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "1- " & Notlar1)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "2- " & Notlar2)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5,	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "3- " & Notlar3)
	res = pe1.Write(pe1.GetBottom+0.5, 	NOTLAR_SATIR_BASLANGIC_KONUM+1, 5, AlanUzunlugu - 24, "4- " & Notlar4)
		'NOTLAR ALTI YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(pe1.GetBottom + 1, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'NOTLARALTI KONUMU
	NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
	PozAciklama = pe1.GetBottom() + 1
	'rows = Doc.SelectEQ("GNMESG","KRITER+KRITER_V+TRNUM","PO  "+STOK46E.EVRAKNO(1)+Space(6))
	'Set Old = Doc.GetTableObject("AU_GNMESG_SELECT")	
	'If rows > 4 And pe1.GetPageCount() = 1 Then msgbox "En fazla 4 satýr mesaj yazabilirsiniz"
	For i = 1 To rows
		If i > 4 Then Exit For
		Mesaj = Old.NOTES(i)
		'If trim(Mesaj) <> "" Then  satirpozr=satirpozr+SatirYuksekligi
		res = pe1.Write(PozAciklama + (2 + i) * sYuksekligi, Solmargin + 2, 5,AlanUzunlugu - 4,Mesaj)		
	Next
	'****************************************************************************************************************
		'AÇIKLAMA - KTA DAN BÝLGÝLERÝ ALIYOR. 
	'******	**********************************************************************************************************
	res = pe1.SetAlign("LEFT")
	res = pe1.SetUnderlined(1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	CALL SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(NOTLAR_ALTI_KONUM + 2, SolMargin + 2,5, 20, "ÖNEMLÝ")
	CALL SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	SATIRATLA = 0
	ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC = pe1.GetBottom + 1
	For n = 1 To 10
		ACIKLAMA_NOT(n) = Doc.GetUDFValue("STOK46E", STOK46E.EVRAKNO, "OZELNOT" & n,0)
		res = pe1.SetUnderlined(0)
		res = pe1.SetBold(0)

		res = pe1.Write(ACIKLAMA_SATIR__BASLANGIC+SATIRATLA, pe1.GetLeft,4,187, "* " & ACIKLAMA_NOT(n) )

	Next
	'*****************************************************************************************************************
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.5)
	res = pe1.Line(AltMargin - 36, SolMargin, 0, AlanUzunlugu)		
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN ÜSTÜ YATAY ÇÝZGÝ ALTI KONUM
	SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM = pe1.GetBottom
		'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 32, "SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	'SÝPARÝÞÝ VEREN SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.PenSize(0.1)
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)	
		'ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN
	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")
	res = pe1.SetBold(1)
	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 45, "ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)
	OPS_ADINA_ONAYLAYAN_SOL_KONUM = pe1.GetLeft
		'ÖPS ADINA ONAYLAYAN  SOL DÝK ÇÝZGÝ
	res = pe1.Line(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM, pe1.GetRight + 0.5, 36, 0)

	res = pe1.SetAlign("CENTER")

	Call SATIRBOYA_AKTIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.Write(SIPARISI_VEREN_UST_KONUM + 1, pe1.GetLeft + 1, 5, 36, "SEVK ÞEKLÝ")
	Call SATIRBOYA_PASIF(pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBold(0)

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Normal(pe1)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		res = pe1.setitalic(0)
		res = pe1.pensize(0.4)
		res = pe1.setbkgcolor(RGB(255, 255, 255))
		res = pe1.setrotation(0)
		res = pe1.settransparentmode(1)
		res = pe1.settextcolor(RGB(0, 0, 0))
		res = pe1.selectfont("Arial", 10)
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
End Sub
'----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_AKTIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(0)
End Sub
'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub SATIRBOYA_PASIF (pe1)
	res = pe1.SetBkgColor(RGB(220,220,220))
	res = pe1.SetTransparentMode(1)
End Sub
