Sub Print_form_satir(pe1, satirNo)
Dim satirpozr
		If trim(STOK26T.KOD(satirNo)) = "" Then Exit Sub
		Degisken = ""
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
		If sonsatir > sayfasonu Then
			Call Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
			siraNo = 0
			res = pe1.PageBreak()
			Call Print_form_sayfabasi(pe1)
			satirpozr = satirBaslangic
		End If		

		siraNo = siraNo + 1
		satirpozr = satirBaslangic + (siraNo - 1) * satiryuksekligi

		res = pe1.selectfont("arial", 9)
		res = pe1.setbold(0)
		Sol = solMargin 		
		res = pe1.setalign("LEFT")
		For i = 0 To UBound(Grid,1)
			SutunGenisligi = Grid(i,1) 
			DegiskenAdi = Grid(i,0)
			

			Select Case trim(degiskenAdi)
				case "_SIRANO"
					sirano1=satirno+1 
					Degisken=sirano			
				case else
					Degisken = STOK26T.GetFieldValue(DegiskenAdi,SatirNo)
			end select
			If Grid(i,4) = "N" Then
				res = pe1.SetAlign("RIGHT")
				Ondalik = Grid(i,6)
				Degisken = Doc.numformat_nlz(degisken, grid(i,1), grid(i,6))
			ElseIf Grid(i,4) = "D" Then
				Degisken = Doc.StrtoNordate(Degisken)
			End If
			res = pe1.write(satirpozr, Sol, satiryuksekligi, SutunGenisligi - 2, Degisken)
			Sol = Sol + SutunGenisligi
			j = j + 1
		Next					 
		sonSatir = pe1.GetBottom()
End Sub
Sub Print_form_sayfasonu(pe1)
	res = pe1.Setalign("LEFT")
	


End Sub

Sub Alanlar()

	ReDim Grid(6, 7)

	Grid(0, 0) = "_SIRANO"

  	Grid(2, 0) = "KOD_STOK00_AD"

	Grid(1,1) = 25
	Grid(2,1) = 70
	Grid(3,1) = 25
	Grid(4,1) = 15
	Grid(5,1) = 35
	
	
	Grid(0,4) = "C"
	Grid(1,4) = "C"
	Grid(2,4) = "C"
	Grid(3,4) = "N"

	Grid(5,4) = "C"

			Degisken = Grid(i,0)

		End If
	Next

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim ExcelApp, Wb1
	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add

	satir = 5
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")

	FOR i = 1 TO MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
	
		satir = satir + 1
	
		IF TRIM(MULTILEVEL.XLEVEL(i)) = 0 THEN

			satir = satir + 1
			MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
			Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "", -1)
			Resim1= trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.GetFieldValue("FULLFILENAME1", 1))
		
		ELSE 

			MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
		
			IF LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="YM" THEN

				Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "", -1)
				Resim1= trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.GetFieldValue("FULLFILENAME1", 1))
		
				IF TRIM(S0P.GetFieldValue("FULLFILENAME1", 1))="" THEN

					Resim1=	Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\RESIMCEK.jpg" 

				END IF
					
			ELSEIF LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),1)="Y" THEN

				Set S0P = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "", -1)
				Resim1= trim(Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & S0P.GetFieldValue("FULLFILENAME1", 2))

			ELSE 
				
				Resim1=""

			END IF

		END IF

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
				
		IF Resim1 <> "" THEN

			Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight*2.5

			rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Top+1.5
								
			rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Left+1.5

			Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1)) 

			resimadi=resim.name
				
			wb1.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
    
			resim.Left = rleft 
			resim.Top = rtop
    		
			ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  			ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 30
  			ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 45

		END IF

			For j = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)

				if Grid(j,1) > 0 Then

					AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
					Deger = MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)

						if Grid(j,4) = "C" Then

							Deger = "'" & Deger
							Deger = Trim(deger)

						End if

					Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,j + 2).Value = Deger
		
				End if

			Next

	NEXT

 	Wb1.Sheets(1).Rows(4).RowHeight = 49.5

	For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)

		baslik = Replace(Grid(i,2),"\n", " ")
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+1).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		'ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 45
		ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+2).Value = trim(baslik)
		Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(i + 2).autofit

	Next

	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select

	Set Wb1 = Nothing
	Set ExcelApp = Nothing



End Sub

Kod : 
Public k(20)

Sub PrintForm()
	'yarým kaldý. resim yok ise stok kartýnda ki kýsma devam et. 18 kasým 2008

	Dim j,ExcelApp, Wb1, S0P1, S0P2, S0P3,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI
	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add

	satir = 5
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")
	maxseviye = 0

	'ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE BELÝRLEME
	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		For j = 2 to 2  ' TABLONUN 2.SUTUNUNDA URUN AGAC SEVÝYESÝ
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = trim(Degerorj)
					if maxseviye < right(seviye,1) then
						maxseviye = right(seviye,1)
					end if
				end if
			End if
		Next
	Next			

	ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = maxseviye	+ 2
	BASLANGIC_KOLONU = 2	

	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(satir-1,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.Name = "YAZILACAK_ALAN" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"YAZILACAK_ALAN"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
		.LeftMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .RightMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .TopMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .BottomMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .HeaderMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .FooterMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .Zoom = False
     .FitToPagesWide = 1
     .FitToPagesTall = 1
     .PrintErrors = xlPrintErrorsDisplayed
     .OddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter = False
     .DifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter = False
     .ScaleWithDocHeaderFooter = True
     .AlignMarginsHeaderFooter = True
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = False
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$2"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""

	End With

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim j, S0P1, S0P2, S0P3,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI, seviye

	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb1.ActiveSheet

ExcelApp.Visible = True
	satir = 3
	baslangic_satiri = satir-1
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")
	maxseviye = 0

	'ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE BELÝRLEME
	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		For j = 2 to 2  ' TABLONUN 2.SUTUNUNDA URUN AGAC SEVÝYESÝ
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = trim(Degerorj)
					If maxseviye < right(seviye,1) then
						maxseviye = right(seviye,1)
					End if
				End if
			End if
		Next
	Next			

	BASLANGIC_KOLONU = 1	

	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
'**********************************************************************************
		'HEM ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE (TABLODA 2.ALAN) HEMDE OPS KODU (TABLODA 4.ALAN) 
		For j = 2 to 4
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then

				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))

				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = right(Degerorj,1) + 1
					AlanAdi2 = Grid(4,0)
					Degerorj2 = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi2, i))

'*********************************************************************************************************************
					If Trim(MULTILEVEL.XLEVEL(i)) = 0 Then
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
						'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
						If S0P1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
							Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
							S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
							Doc.Save_Voucher
							Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
						End If
						Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Resim2 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						URUNAGACIFOYNO = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", MAMULKODU & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF")
					Else 
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						If Left(Trim(MamulKodu),2)="YM" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HS" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HR" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P2 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P2.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc.Save_Voucher
								Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						ElseIf Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="SRT" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YON" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YTC" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YAI" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FAI" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FON" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P3 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)

								Doc1.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								Set S0P4 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK0P")	
								S0P4.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc1.Save_Voucher
								Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher

							End If

						Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1))

		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(13,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(14,2),"\n", " ") & " (saat)"
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(15,2),"\n", " ") & " (saat)"
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(16,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(17,2),"\n", " ")	
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(18,2),"\n", " ")		
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(20,2),"\n", " ")	
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(22,2),"\n", " ")	
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(33,2),"\n", " ")	

		TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ
		Sheet.Cells.Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.RowHeight = 37.5
		ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 1 'xlTop

		'BAÞLIK BOYA
		For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
			Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, i).Select
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Size = 9
			ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
			ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
			ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True 
			ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
			ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Next
	
		Sheet.Rows("2:2").Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.RowHeight = 111

		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-10),Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-3)).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 90
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1),Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1)).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 90
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, 2), Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, AGAC_SONU_KOLONU-1)).Merge

		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, 1),Sheet.Cells(satir-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1			'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1			'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(10).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi, 4:kalýn

			ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True

		Next

		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri-1, 1), Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Merge
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).value = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri+1,2).value & " - " & Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri+1,AGAC_SONU_KOLONU).value & "  //  [ FÖY NO: " & Trim(URUNAGACIFOYNO) & " ] "

		With ExcelApp.Selection

		For h = -1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI

			resim.Top = rtop

		Resim2 = ""

		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select

		Call Yaziciya_Yazdir

		Set Wb1 = Nothing
		Set ExcelApp = Nothing

End Sub
'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(satir-1,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.Name = "YAZILACAK_ALAN" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"YAZILACAK_ALAN"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
		.LeftMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .RightMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .TopMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .BottomMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .HeaderMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .FooterMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .Zoom = False
     .FitToPagesWide = 1
     .FitToPagesTall = 1
     .PrintErrors = xlPrintErrorsDisplayed
     .OddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter = False
     .DifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter = False
     .ScaleWithDocHeaderFooter = True
     .AlignMarginsHeaderFooter = True
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = False
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$2"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""

	End With

End Sub

Public k(20),TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI,satir,sheet,ExcelApp,wb1,mamulkodu

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim j, S0P1, S0P2, S0P3,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI, seviye

	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb1.ActiveSheet

ExcelApp.Visible = True
	satir = 3
	baslangic_satiri = satir-1
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")
	maxseviye = 0

	'ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE BELÝRLEME
	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		For j = 2 to 2  ' TABLONUN 2.SUTUNUNDA URUN AGAC SEVÝYESÝ
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = trim(Degerorj)
					If maxseviye < right(seviye,1) then
						maxseviye = right(seviye,1)
					End if
				End if
			End if
		Next
	Next			

	BASLANGIC_KOLONU = 2	

	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
'**********************************************************************************
		'HEM ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE (TABLODA 2.ALAN) HEMDE OPS KODU (TABLODA 4.ALAN) 
		For j = 2 to 4
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))

				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = right(Degerorj,1) + 1
					AlanAdi2 = Grid(4,0)
					Degerorj2 = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi2, i))

'*********************************************************************************************************************
					If Trim(MULTILEVEL.XLEVEL(i)) = 0 Then
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
						'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
						If S0P1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
							Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
							S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
							Doc.Save_Voucher
							Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
						End If
						Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Resim2 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						URUNAGACIFOYNO = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", MAMULKODU & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF")
					Else 
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						If Left(Trim(MamulKodu),2)="YM" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HS" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HR" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P2 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P2.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc.Save_Voucher
								Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						ElseIf Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="SRT" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YON" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YTC" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YAI" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FAI" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FON" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P3 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P3.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK00", "")
								Doc1.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								Set S0P4 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK0P")	
								S0P4.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc1.Save_Voucher
								Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
								Doc.DeleteDocumentNoUI "	STOK00", ""
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P3.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Else
							'msgbox "kodu ve resimi kontrol et"
							Resim1 = ""
						End If
					End If
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
					If Resim1 <> "" THEN
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight*2.5
						rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Top+1.5
						rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Left+1.5
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, 1).Select
						Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1)) 
						resimadi=resim.name
						wb1.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
						resim.Left = rleft 
						resim.Top = rtop
						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 30
  						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 45
					End If
'******************************************************************************
					Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, BASLANGIC_KOLONU+seviye).Value = Degerorj2
				End if
			End if
		Next

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 2.KOLON (OP.NO)
		For j = 1 to 1
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,2).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		AGAC_SONU_KOLONU = 	maxseviye + 3
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU + 1

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 7.KOLON
		For j = 7 to 7
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'OPERASYON ADI KISMI TABLODAKÝ 9.KOLON
		For j = 9 to 9

				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))

			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'BÝRÝM KISMI TABLODAKÝ 10.KOLON
		For j = 10 to 10
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ(SETUP HARÝÇ) (SAAT) KISMI TABLODAKÝ 11.KOLON
		For j = 11 to 11

				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)

			End if

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ(SETUP HARÝÇ) (DAKÝKA) 12.KOLON
		For j = 12 to 12

				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)

			End if

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)

				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

			End if

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ (SETUP DAHÝL) (SANÝYE) 18.KOLON

			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)

				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj

		'ELDE EDÝLEN ÜRÜN KODU MÝKTARI KISMI TABLODAKÝ 22.KOLON

			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj

		'REÇETE NOTU KISMI TABLODAKÝ 33.KOLON
		For j = 33 to 33
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next
	satir = satir + 1
	Next

 	Wb1.Sheets(1).Rows(4).RowHeight = 49.5
	'For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
	'	baslik = Replace(Grid(i,2),"\n", " ")

		'ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 45
		ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True

		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,2).Value = "OP.NO"
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,3).Value = "ÖPS Kodlamasý"
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(7,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(9,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(10,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(11,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(12,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(13,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(14,2),"\n", " ") & " (saat)"
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(15,2),"\n", " ") & " (saat)"
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(17,2),"\n", " ")	
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(18,2),"\n", " ")		
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(20,2),"\n", " ")	
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1

		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(33,2),"\n", " ")	

		TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ
		Sheet.Cells.Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.RowHeight = 37.5
		ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 1 'xlTop

		'BAÞLIK BOYA
		For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
			Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, i).Select
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Size = 9
			ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
			ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
			ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True 
			ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
			ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Next
	
		Sheet.Rows("2:2").Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.RowHeight = 111

		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-10),Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-3)).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 90
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1),Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1)).Select

		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, 3), Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, AGAC_SONU_KOLONU)).Merge

		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select

		Call Yaziciya_Yazdir

		Set Wb1 = Nothing
		Set ExcelApp = Nothing

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(satir-1,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.Name = "YAZILACAK_ALAN" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"YAZILACAK_ALAN"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
		.LeftMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .RightMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .TopMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .BottomMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .HeaderMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .FooterMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .Zoom = False
     .FitToPagesWide = 1
     .FitToPagesTall = 1
     .PrintErrors = xlPrintErrorsDisplayed
     .OddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter = False
     .DifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter = False
     .ScaleWithDocHeaderFooter = True
     .AlignMarginsHeaderFooter = True
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = False
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$2"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""

	End With

End Sub

Public k(20),TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI,satir,sheet,ExcelApp,wb1,mamulkodu

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim j, S0P1, S0P2, S0P3,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI, seviye

	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb1.ActiveSheet

	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	satir = 3
	baslangic_satiri = satir-1
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")
	maxseviye = 0

	'ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE BELÝRLEME
	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		For j = 2 to 2  ' TABLONUN 2.SUTUNUNDA URUN AGAC SEVÝYESÝ
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = trim(Degerorj)
					If maxseviye < right(seviye,1) then
						maxseviye = right(seviye,1)
					End if
				End if
			End if
		Next
	Next			

	BASLANGIC_KOLONU = 2	

	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
'**********************************************************************************
		'HEM ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE (TABLODA 2.ALAN) HEMDE OPS KODU (TABLODA 4.ALAN) 
		For j = 2 to 4
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))

				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = right(Degerorj,1) + 1
					AlanAdi2 = Grid(4,0)
					Degerorj2 = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi2, i))

'*********************************************************************************************************************
					If Trim(MULTILEVEL.XLEVEL(i)) = 0 Then
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
						'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
						If S0P1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
							Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
							S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
							Doc.Save_Voucher
							Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
						End If
						Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Resim2 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						URUNAGACIFOYNO = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", MAMULKODU & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF")
					Else 
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						If Left(Trim(MamulKodu),2)="YM" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HS" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HR" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P2 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P2.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc.Save_Voucher
								Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						ElseIf Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="SRT" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YON" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YTC" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YAI" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FAI" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FON" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P3 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P3.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK00", "")
								Doc1.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								Set S0P4 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK0P")	
								S0P4.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc1.Save_Voucher
								Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
								Doc.DeleteDocumentNoUI "	STOK00", ""
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P3.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Else
							'msgbox "kodu ve resimi kontrol et"
							Resim1 = ""
						End If
					End If
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
					If Resim1 <> "" THEN
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight*2.5
						rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Top+1.5
						rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Left+1.5
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, 1).Select
						Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1)) 
						resimadi=resim.name
						wb1.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
						resim.Left = rleft 
						resim.Top = rtop
						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 30
  						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 45
					End If
'******************************************************************************
					Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, BASLANGIC_KOLONU+seviye).Value = Degerorj2
				End if
			End if
		Next

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 2.KOLON (OP.NO)
		For j = 1 to 1
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,2).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		AGAC_SONU_KOLONU = 	maxseviye + 3
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU + 1

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 7.KOLON
		For j = 7 to 7
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'OPERASYON ADI KISMI TABLODAKÝ 9.KOLON
		For j = 9 to 9
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'BÝRÝM KISMI TABLODAKÝ 10.KOLON
		For j = 10 to 10
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ(SETUP HARÝÇ) (SAAT) KISMI TABLODAKÝ 11.KOLON
		For j = 11 to 11

				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ(SETUP HARÝÇ) (DAKÝKA) 12.KOLON
		For j = 12 to 12
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ(SETUP HARÝÇ) (SANÝYE) 13.KOLON

				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 0)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'AYAR SETUP (SAAT) TABLODAKÝ 14.KOLON
		For j = 14 to 14
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'YÜKLEME (SAAT) TABLODAKÝ 15.KOLON
		For j = 15 to 15
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ (SETUP DAHÝL) (SAAT) TABLODAKÝ 16.KOLON

			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ (SETUP DAHÝL) (DAKÝKA) TABLODAKÝ 17.KOLON
		For j = 17 to 17
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ (SETUP DAHÝL) (SANÝYE) 18.KOLON

				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'ELDE EDÝLEN ÜRÜN KODU KISMI TABLODAKÝ 20.KOLON

			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)

				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

			End if

	Next

 	Wb1.Sheets(1).Rows(4).RowHeight = 49.5
	'For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
	'	baslik = Replace(Grid(i,2),"\n", " ")
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,1).Select

		'ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 45
		ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True

		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,3).Value = "ÖPS Kodlamasý"
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(7,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(9,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(10,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(11,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(12,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(13,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(14,2),"\n", " ") & " (saat)"
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(15,2),"\n", " ") & " (saat)"
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(16,2),"\n", " ")
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(17,2),"\n", " ")	
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(18,2),"\n", " ")		
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(20,2),"\n", " ")	
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(22,2),"\n", " ")	
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(33,2),"\n", " ")	

		TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ
		Sheet.Cells.Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.RowHeight = 37.5
		ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 1 'xlTop

		'BAÞLIK BOYA
		For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
			Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, i).Select
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Size = 9
			ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
			ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.ColorIndex = 1 '1:SÝYAH 2:GRÝ,3:KIRMIZI
			ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True 
			ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter 
			ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter 
		Next
	
		Sheet.Rows("2:2").Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.RowHeight = 111

		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-10),Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-3)).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 90
		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1),Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1)).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 90

		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, 1),Sheet.Cells(satir-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(1).LineStyle = 1  		'.Borders(1):sol dik çizgi,.Borders(3)=üst yatay çizgi,(4):alt yatay çizgi, (5):çapraz \,(6):çapraz:/,(10):sað dik çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1			'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1			'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(3).Weight = 2 			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(10).LineStyle = 1  	'.Border(10):seçili alanýn en sað dik çizgisi

		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select

		Call Yaziciya_Yazdir

		Set Wb1 = Nothing
		Set ExcelApp = Nothing

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(satir-1,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.Name = "YAZILACAK_ALAN" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"YAZILACAK_ALAN"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
		.LeftMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .RightMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .TopMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .BottomMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .HeaderMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .FooterMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .Zoom = False
     .FitToPagesWide = 1
     .FitToPagesTall = 1
     .PrintErrors = xlPrintErrorsDisplayed
     .OddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter = False
     .DifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter = False
     .ScaleWithDocHeaderFooter = True
     .AlignMarginsHeaderFooter = True
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = False
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$2"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""

	End With

End Sub

Public k(20),TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI,satir,sheet,ExcelApp,wb1,mamulkodu

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim j, S0P1, S0P2, S0P3,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI, seviye

	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb1.ActiveSheet

	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	satir = 3
	baslangic_satiri = satir-1
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")
	maxseviye = 0

	'ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE BELÝRLEME
	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		For j = 2 to 2  ' TABLONUN 2.SUTUNUNDA URUN AGAC SEVÝYESÝ
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = trim(Degerorj)
					If maxseviye < right(seviye,1) then
						maxseviye = right(seviye,1)
					End if
				End if
			End if
		Next
	Next			

	BASLANGIC_KOLONU = 2	

	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
'**********************************************************************************
		'HEM ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE (TABLODA 2.ALAN) HEMDE OPS KODU (TABLODA 4.ALAN) 
		For j = 2 to 4
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))

				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = right(Degerorj,1) + 1
					AlanAdi2 = Grid(4,0)
					Degerorj2 = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi2, i))

'*********************************************************************************************************************
					If Trim(MULTILEVEL.XLEVEL(i)) = 0 Then
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
						'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
						If S0P1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
							Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
							S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
							Doc.Save_Voucher
							Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
						End If
						Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Resim2 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						URUNAGACIFOYNO = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", MAMULKODU & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF")
					Else 
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						If Left(Trim(MamulKodu),2)="YM" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HS" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HR" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P2 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P2.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc.Save_Voucher
								Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						ElseIf Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="SRT" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YON" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YTC" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YAI" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FAI" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FON" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P3 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P3.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK00", "")
								Doc1.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								Set S0P4 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK0P")	
								S0P4.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc1.Save_Voucher
								Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
								Doc.DeleteDocumentNoUI "	STOK00", ""
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P3.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Else
							'msgbox "kodu ve resimi kontrol et"
							Resim1 = ""
						End If
					End If
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
					If Resim1 <> "" THEN
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight*2.5
						rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Top+1.5
						rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Left+1.5
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, 1).Select
						Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1)) 
						resimadi=resim.name
						wb1.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
						resim.Left = rleft 
						resim.Top = rtop
						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 30
  						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 45
					End If
'******************************************************************************
					Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, BASLANGIC_KOLONU+seviye).Value = Degerorj2
				End if
			End if
		Next

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 2.KOLON (OP.NO)
		For j = 1 to 1
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,2).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		AGAC_SONU_KOLONU = 	maxseviye + 3
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU + 1

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 7.KOLON
		For j = 7 to 7
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'OPERASYON ADI KISMI TABLODAKÝ 9.KOLON
		For j = 9 to 9
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'BÝRÝM KISMI TABLODAKÝ 10.KOLON
		For j = 10 to 10
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ(SETUP HARÝÇ) (SAAT) KISMI TABLODAKÝ 11.KOLON
		For j = 11 to 11
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ(SETUP HARÝÇ) (DAKÝKA) 12.KOLON
		For j = 12 to 12
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 2)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'TEZGAH SÜRESÝ(SETUP HARÝÇ) (SANÝYE) 13.KOLON
		For j = 13 to 13
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Degerorj	= 	Doc.NumFormat(Degerorj,20, 0)
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj

		Sheet.Cells.Select

			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Size = 9
			ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR
			ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.Pattern =1 '1:xlSolid,2:noktalý3:çizgili

			ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True 
			ExcelApp.Selection.HorizontalAlignment = 3 'xlCenter

		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1),Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI-1)).Select

		Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, 1),Sheet.Cells(satir-1, TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select

		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(1).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(4).LineStyle = 1			'.Borders(4):alt yatay çigi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(4).Weight = 2  			'1:noktalý,2:çizgi
		ExcelApp.Selection.Borders(3).LineStyle = 1			'.Borders(3):üst yatay çigi

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(satir-1,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.Name = "YAZILACAK_ALAN" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"YAZILACAK_ALAN"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
		.LeftMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .RightMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .TopMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .BottomMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .HeaderMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .FooterMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .Zoom = False
     .FitToPagesWide = 1
     .FitToPagesTall = 1
     .PrintErrors = xlPrintErrorsDisplayed
     .OddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter = False
     .DifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter = False
     .ScaleWithDocHeaderFooter = True
     .AlignMarginsHeaderFooter = True
		.CenterHorizontally = True
		.CenterVertically = False
		.Orientation = 2
		.Draft = False
		.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$2"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""

	End With

End Sub

Public k(20),TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI,satir,sheet,ExcelApp,wb1,mamulkodu

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim j, S0P1, S0P2, S0P3,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI, seviye

	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb1.ActiveSheet

	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	satir = 3
	baslangic_satiri = satir-1
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")
	maxseviye = 0

	'ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE BELÝRLEME
	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		For j = 2 to 2  ' TABLONUN 2.SUTUNUNDA URUN AGAC SEVÝYESÝ
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = trim(Degerorj)
					If maxseviye < right(seviye,1) then
						maxseviye = right(seviye,1)
					End if
				End if
			End if
		Next
	Next			

	BASLANGIC_KOLONU = 2	

	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
'**********************************************************************************
		'HEM ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE (TABLODA 2.ALAN) HEMDE OPS KODU (TABLODA 4.ALAN) 
		For j = 2 to 4
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))

				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = right(Degerorj,1) + 1
					AlanAdi2 = Grid(4,0)
					Degerorj2 = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi2, i))

'*********************************************************************************************************************
					If Trim(MULTILEVEL.XLEVEL(i)) = 0 Then
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						Set S0P1 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
						'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
						If S0P1.GetRowCount = 0 Then
							Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
							S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
							Doc.Save_Voucher
							Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
						End If
						Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Resim2 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P1.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						URUNAGACIFOYNO = Doc.GetDBFieldValue("BOMU01E", "EVRAKNO", MAMULKODU & "*", "MAMULCODE+AKTIF_PASIF")
					Else 
						MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
						If Left(Trim(MamulKodu),2)="YM" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HS" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),2)="HR" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P2 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P2.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Doc.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc.Save_Voucher
								Doc.LoadEmpty_Voucher
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P2.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						ElseIf Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="SRT" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YVN" OR Left(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YON" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YTC" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="YAI" Or LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FAI" OR LEFT(TRIM(MamulKodu),3)="FON" Then
							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P3 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)
							'EÐER RESÝM SATIRI BOÞ ÝSE STOK KARTINI AÇ, 1.SATIRA RESÝMÇEK YAZISINI YAZ.
							If S0P3.GetRowCount = 0 Then
								Set Doc1 = Doc.CreateDocumentNoUI("STOK00", "")
								Doc1.Load_Voucher MamulKodu
								Set S0P4 = Doc.GetTableObject("STOK0P")	
								S0P4.FULLFILENAME1(1) = "RESIMCEK.jpg"
								Doc1.Save_Voucher
								Doc1.LoadEmpty_Voucher
								Doc.DeleteDocumentNoUI "	STOK00", ""
							End If
							Resim1 = Doc.Getd7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Trim(S0P3.FULLFILENAME1(1))
						Else
							'msgbox "kodu ve resimi kontrol et"
							Resim1 = ""
						End If
					End If
'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
					If Resim1 <> "" THEN
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).rowheight*2.5
						rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Top+1.5
						rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,1).Left+1.5
						Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, 1).Select
						Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1)) 
						resimadi=resim.name
						wb1.ActiveSheet.Shapes(resimadi).Select
						resim.Left = rleft 
						resim.Top = rtop
						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.LockAspectRatio = msoFalse
  						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Height = 30
  						ExcelApp.selection.ShapeRange.Width = 45
					End If
'******************************************************************************
					Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir, BASLANGIC_KOLONU+seviye).Value = Degerorj2
				End if
			End if
		Next

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 2.KOLON (OP.NO)
		For j = 1 to 1
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,2).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		AGAC_SONU_KOLONU = 	maxseviye + 3
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU
		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = AGAC_SONU_KOLONU + 1

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'AÇIKLAMA KISMI TABLODAKÝ 7.KOLON
		For j = 7 to 7
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = "'" & Degerorj
			End if
		Next

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI + 1

		'OPERASYON ADI KISMI TABLODAKÝ 9.KOLON
		For j = 9 to 9
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI).Value = Degerorj
			End if
		Next

			End if
		Next

		satir = satir + 1
	Next

 	Wb1.Sheets(1).Rows(4).RowHeight = 49.5
	'For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
	'	baslik = Replace(Grid(i,2),"\n", " ")
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,1).Select

		'ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 45
		ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True

		ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ + 1
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(baslangic_satiri,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ).Value = Replace(Grid(20,2),"\n", " ")

		TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI = ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI_ORJ
		Sheet.Cells.Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.RowHeight = 37.5
		ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 1 'xlTop

		For i = 1 to TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI
			Sheet.Cells(baslangic_satiri, i).Select
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
			ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Size = 9
			ExcelApp.Selection.Interior.ColorIndex = 19   '15:GRI,1:SIYAH,2:beyaz,3:kýrmýzý,4:yeþil,5:mavi,6:sarý,7:pembe,8:magenta,9:koyukahve,10:KOYUYEÞÝL,11:LACIVERT,12:BOKYESILI,12:MOR

			ExcelApp.Selection.VerticalAlignment = 2 'xlCenter

		'ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 90

'-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Sub Yaziciya_Yazdir ()

 	Sheet.Range(Sheet.Cells(1, 1),Sheet.Cells(satir-1,TOPLAMKOLONSAYISI)).Select
	ExcelApp.Selection.Name = "YAZILACAK_ALAN" 
	Sheet.PageSetup.PrintArea = 	"YAZILACAK_ALAN"

	With Sheet.PageSetup
  		.CenterFooter = "Page &P of &N"
		.LeftMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .RightMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.12)
     .TopMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .BottomMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.2)
     .HeaderMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .FooterMargin = ExcelApp.InchesToPoints(0.02)
     .Zoom = False
     .FitToPagesWide = 1
     .FitToPagesTall = 1
     .PrintErrors = xlPrintErrorsDisplayed
     .OddAndEvenPagesHeaderFooter = False
     .DifferentFirstPageHeaderFooter = False
     '.ScaleWithDocHeaderFooter = True
     '.AlignMarginsHeaderFooter = True
		.CenterHorizontally = False
		.CenterVertically = False
		.Orientation = 1
		.Draft = False
		'.PrintTitleRows = "$1:$2"
		.PrintTitleColumns = ""

	End With

End Sub

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim j, S0P1, S0P2, S0P3,ACIKLAMA_KOLON_BASLANGICI, seviye

	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add
	Set Sheet = Wb1.ActiveSheet

	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	satir = 3
	baslangic_satiri = satir-1
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")
	maxseviye = 0

	'ÜRÜN AÐACI SEVÝYE BELÝRLEME
	For i = 1 To MULTILEVEL.GetRecCount()
		For j = 2 to 2  ' TABLONUN 2.SUTUNUNDA URUN AGAC SEVÝYESÝ
			If Grid(j,1) > 0 Then
				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Degerorj = Trim(MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i))
				If AlanAdi = "PICTURE_LEVEL1" then
					Seviye = trim(Degerorj)
					If maxseviye < right(seviye,1) then
						maxseviye = right(seviye,1)
					End if
				End if
			End if
		Next

	BASLANGIC_KOLONU = 2	
'*******************************************************************************************

'**********************************************************************************

							MamulKodu = Doc.LeftJustify(trim(MULTILEVEL.TREE_CODE(i)), 24)
							Set S0P2 = Doc.Select1("dddtyy", "STOK0P", "EVRAKNO='" & MamulKodu & "'", "SUBSRNUM", -1)

						Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1))

Sub PrintForm()

	Dim ExcelApp, Wb1
	Set ExcelApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
	ExcelApp.Visible = True
	
	Set Wb1 = ExcelApp.Workbooks.Add

	Set ML_Table = Doc.Select2("ffrr", "MULTILEVEL", "", "", -1)
	ML_Table.Sort("BOMREC_KAYNAKCODE")

	'Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Value = "Mamul Kodu"
	'Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(2,1).Value = "Mamul Miktarý"
	'Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,2).Value = BOMU01E.MAMULCODE
	'Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(2,2).Value = BOMU01E.MAMULMIKTAR

	satir = 5
	Grid = Doc.GetGridColInfo("","MULTILEVEL")

	For i = 1 To ML_Table.GetRecCount()

		For j = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)

			if Grid(j,1) > 0 Then

				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Deger = MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)

				if Grid(j,4) = "C" Then

					Deger = "'" & Deger
					Deger = Trim(deger)

				End if

				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir + i - 1,j + 1).Value = Deger

			End if
		Next

	Next

 	Wb1.Sheets(1).Rows(4).RowHeight = 49.5

	For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)

		baslik = Replace(Grid(i,2),"\n", " ")
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+1).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+1).Value = trim(baslik)
		Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(i + 1).autofit

	Next

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	'RESÝM EKLE	

	mamulkod=BOMU01E.MAMULCODE
	
	resim1 = Doc.GetD7Directory_DataFirm & "images\" & Doc.GetDbFieldValue("STOK0P", "FULLFILENAME1", mamulkod +"000001", "EVRAKNO+TRNUM")


	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,4).columnwidth = 50
	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,4).rowheight = 100

	rtop = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,4).Top 
	rleft= Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,4).Left 

	Set resim = Wb1.ActiveSheet.Pictures.Insert(trim(resim1)) 
	resim.Left = rleft 
	resim.Top = rtop

	resim.width = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,4).columnwidth
	resim.height = Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,4).rowheight

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select

	Set Wb1 = Nothing
	Set ExcelApp = Nothing

   '     .IndentLevel = 0
   '     .ShrinkToFit = False
   '     .ReadingOrder = xlContext
   '     .MergeCells = False
   ' End With

'---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
			
		End if

		For j = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
			if Grid(j,1) > 0 Then

				AlanAdi = Grid(j,0)
				Deger = MULTILEVEL.GetFieldValue(AlanAdi, i)

				if Grid(j,4) = "C" Then

					Deger = "'" & Deger
					Deger = Trim(deger)

				End if

				Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(satir,j + 2).Value = Deger
		
			End if
		Next

	Next

 	Wb1.Sheets(1).Rows(4).RowHeight = 49.5

	For i = 0 to uBound(Grid, 1)
		baslik = Replace(Grid(i,2),"\n", " ")
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+1).Select
		ExcelApp.Selection.Font.Bold = True
		'ExcelApp.Selection.Orientation = 45
		ExcelApp.Selection.WrapText = True
		Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(4,i+2).Value = trim(baslik)
		Wb1.ActiveSheet.Columns(i + 2).autofit
	Next

	'WB1.ActiveSheet.cells.select
	'	With ExcelApp.Selection
        '.HorizontalAlignment = xlGeneral
   '     .VerticalAlignment = xlCenter
        '.WrapText = False
        '.Orientation = 0
        '.AddIndent = False
        '.IndentLevel = 0
        '.ShrinkToFit = False
        '.ReadingOrder = xlContext
        '.MergeCells = False
    'End With

	Wb1.Sheets(1).cells(1,1).Select

	Set Wb1 = Nothing
	Set ExcelApp = Nothing

End Sub

Form Kaynak Kodu
Firma Kodu : OPS / Uygulama : PFRM7S
Makro Kodu : W-Form
Hangi Tablo için : PFRM7S
Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : 
Açýklama : TUM FORM KODLARI WORDE AKTARIR
Kod : 
Public strfind(8)
Sub PrintForm()
	
	Dim objDoc, objWord, Selection
	Set objWord = CreateObject( "Word.Application" )
	objWord.visible = True
	Set objDoc = objWord.Documents.Add()
	Set Selection = objWord.Selection
	'objWord.Selection.EndKey 6,0
	FirmKodu = Trim(Doc.Getd7FirmCode())
	Uygulama = Trim(Doc.GetDocType)

	Set PFR7SE = Doc.Select1("dd333d", "PFRM7SE", "", "EVRAKNO", -1)
	'Set MKR7SE = Doc.Select1("dd333d", "MAKR7SE", "EVRAKNO = '_GNPRG1'", "", -1)
	
	KayitSayisi = PFR7SE.GetRecCount()
	'-------------------------------------------------
	'Satýr boþluk ayarýný yapar.
	Selection.ParagraphFormat.LineSpacing = 10
	objWord.ActiveDocument.ShowSpellingErrors = False
	'----------------------------------------------
	'Tab ayarýný yapar.
	objWord.ActiveDocument.DefaultTabStop = 15
	'---------------------------------------------
	For i = 1 To KayitSayisi
		EVRAKKODU_ORJ = Trim(PFR7SE.EVRAKNO(i))
		If Left(EVRAKKODU_ORJ, 2) <> "++" Then
			EVRAKKODU = Trim(PFR7SE.EVRAKNO(i))

			Kodlar = ""
			EKodlar = ""
			Selection.Paragraphs.Alignment = 1   '1:wdAlignParagraphCenter yani üst satýrdakini ortalar.
			Selection.TypeText "Form Kaynak Kodu"
			Selection.Typeparagraph
		
			Selection.Paragraphs.Alignment = 3
			Selection.TypeText "Firma Kodu : " & FirmKodu  & " / " & "Uygulama : " &  Uygulama
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Makro Kodu : " & EVRAKKODU 
			'------------------------
		
			'Selection.Paragraphs.Alignment = 1 wdAlignParagraphCenter yani üst satýrdakini ortalar.
			'2: wdAlignParagraphRight yani üst satýrdakini saga yaslar.
			'3: wdAlignParagraphRight yani üst satýrdakini sola yaslar.
		
			Selection.Paragraphs.Alignment = 3
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Hangi Tablo için : " & Trim(PFR7SE.DOCTYPE(i))
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : " & Trim(PFR7SE.ADDDOCTYPES(i))
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Açýklama : " & Trim(PFR7SE.ACIKLAMA(i))
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.TypeText "Kod : "
			Selection.Typeparagraph

			Set PFR7ST = Doc.Select1("dd333d", "PFRM7ST", "EVRAKNO='"&EVRAKKODU&"'",">SRNUM", -1)

			For k = 1 To PFR7ST.GetRecCount()
				Selection.Font.Color = vbBlue
				Kodlar = Kodlar & PFR7ST.SCRIPTTEXT_RO(k)
			Next

			Selection.TypeText Kodlar
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			'-----------------------------------
			Selection.Typeparagraph
			'-----------------------------------
			Selection.Font.Color = vbBlack
			Set PFR7SE= Doc.Select1("dd333d", "PFRM7SE", "", "", -1)
		
			Selection.TypeText "----------------------------------------------------------------"
			Selection.Typeparagraph
		End If
	Next
	'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
	'Font lara makyaj
	For j = 1  To 8
		strfind(1) = "Makro Kaynak Kodu"
		strfind(2) = "Makro Kodu : "
		strfind(3) = "Hangi Tablo için : "
		strfind(4) = "Ýlave Hangi Uygulamalar için : "
		strfind(5) = "Açýklama : "
		strfind(6) = "Kod : "
		strfind(7) = "Firma Kodu : "
		strfind(8) = "Uygulama : "

		Set objRange = objWord.ActiveDocument.Content
		
		With objRange.Find
		.Text = strfind(j)
		Do
			.Execute
			If .Found Then
				objRange.Font.Color = vbRed
				objRange.Font.Bold = True
				'If j = 1 Then objWord.ParagraphFormat.Alignment = wdAlignParagraphCenter
			End If
			Loop While .Found
			End With
		Next
		Selection.WholeStory
		'----------------------------------------------------
		'Satýr sonlarýndaki boþluðu alma
		Selection.ParagraphFormat.SpaceAfter = 0.5
		'---------------------------------------------------
		'Sayfanýn kenarlarýný daralt
		With objWord.ActiveDocument.PageSetup
			.Orientation = wdOrientLandscape
			bosluk = 15
			.TopMargin = bosluk
			.BottomMargin = bosluk
			.LeftMargin = 43
			.RightMargin = bosluk
		End With
		'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
		'Satýr numaralarý ekler
    With Selection.PageSetup
        With .LineNumbering
            .Active = True
            .StartingNumber = 1
            .CountBy = 1
            .RestartMode = 1
            .DistanceFromText = 0
        End With
		End With
		'--------------------------------------------------------------------------
		objWord.visible = True
		desktoppath = CreateObject("WScript.Shell").SpecialFolders("Desktop")
		objDoc.SaveAs(desktoppath & "\" & FirmKodu & "_" & Uygulama)
		Msgbox "Masaüstüne kaydedildi..."
		Set objDoc = Nothing
		Set oWords = Nothing
		Set objWord = Nothing
End Sub
